compare.summary:
G01 Customers (package 1), checked against the code on 2026-10-06: ServicioSAP at 6214ed8 plus the uncommitted S1-S4 edits, DMZ at ConexionSAP 09cb341, LAN at stage-delta. All 5 DMZ routes in DMZ Controllers/CustomersController.cs already call ServicioSAP through PostSAP (:30, :70, :88, :106, :120). No DMZ route is missing from the list. The LAN controller also has two LAN-only routes, customer/getCuenta and customer/setCuenta (LAN CustomersController.cs:90, :99). They have no DMZ route; I include them for completeness.

Parity by process:
- deleteCustomerList, getCustomerList and cashCustomerReport have the same business rules as LAN in code (EQ_ACCEPTED). What remains open is verification against the SIGMavi SP body, which no one can read today (CQ16), plus the Logger risk (CQ21).
- setCustomerList is PARTIAL. The C# matches LAN. But 8 effect rules cannot be checked until we get the SIGMavi SP body. There is also a new risk: S4 now uppercases the email when it creates the BP, and the list insert looks up the BP by email in BP05 with an exact `Mail eq` match.
- setCustomer (partner/client) is PARTIAL. S1-S4 fixed the response contract (it now returns the BP number as a string, BusinessPartnerController.cs:60). They also added the empty-Partner guard (:48-59), Sntz on the same 7 fields as LAN, uppercase names and email, and int.Parse(idMagento). The biggest gap left is the critical one: LAN's SP looks up the existing customer by idMagento (plus email for guests), updates it and returns the same account. ServicioSAP always sends Partner="" (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:435), so every call or retry creates a new BP. This waits on CQ2/CQ3 (D-19) and on the BP05 filter test (D-15).
- Also open in setCustomer: the storeCode/mavi mapping (R4, the storeCode part of CQ5 was not answered), the error contract for exceptions (C-12/X-2), and the buro flag (CQ11). There is also a new conflict: the real payload captured for CQ10 has an empty idMagento and storeCode. With LAN-style int.Parse, that payload now fails.

Changes since the 2026-10-05 matrix (§4.1):
- Row 85 says partner/client still returns the whole Client object. It now returns Partner.Trim().
- Rows 87 and 88 list getCustomerList and deleteCustomerList as partial because of CQ12. The rethrow is now in CustomerMethods.cs:68.
- setCustomerList now URL-encodes the email in the BP05 filter (CustomerMethods.cs:83).

Release notes (not parity gaps):
- origin/master and Stage of the DMZ still send these routes to LAN.
- Deploy ServicioSAP before the DMZ.
- The SIGMavi production list data must be loaded first (T1.L-04).
- None of the S1-S4 changes has been tested end to end yet (S6).

processes.what_lan_does: Registers the Magento customer in Intelisis. SP_eCommerceCtenuevo first looks up Cte by IdMagento (plus eMail1 when the id is 2 or less, i.e. guests). If the customer exists, it updates names, email and address and returns the same account. If not, it creates a new C account (MAX+1) with the CONTADO channel of the store's UEN in Cte and CteEnviarA. It always returns the account as a plain string.

gaps.rule: Find the existing customer before creating, update it, and return the same account. With idMagento > 2, the idMagento alone identifies the customer. With idMagento <= 2 (guest), idMagento and email together identify it. One account per guest email.
gaps.lan: SP_eCommerceCtenuevo.sql:62-68 lookup; :172-201 UPDATE of names, email and address (with id <= 2 only Nombre and address); :205-206 returns the existing @Clave
gaps.ss: MISSING: BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:435 always sends Partner="" to BP01, so every call creates a new BP. BusinessPartnerController.cs:46-60 has no lookup. GetFilterClientsAsync (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:218-260) could query BP05 but is not called. Not yet proven that BP05 accepts $filter on ZidMagento/Mail.
gaps.owner: User + Marcos (SAP/ABAP if BP05 cannot filter)
gaps.action: Steps: (1) Run the read-only step 0 (D-15): GET partner/client/filter/ZidMagento eq <test id>, without quotes. (2) User answers CQ2. Options: a) return the existing BP; b) also update names and email with a partial BP01 payload; c) replicate the SP update including the address wipe; d) keep creating. Which BP wins when several share a ZidMagento (OrderMethods writes ZidMagento; unircuenta PATCHes it)? Recommendation: a (or b without the address wipe), tie-break on the highest Partner, never c. (3) User answers CQ3: do guests (idMagento 0-2) still call setCustomer, and do they get one BP per email (LAN) or the fixed guest BP of the order flow? This also decides whether guest emails can ever pass the setCustomerList BP05 check. (4) CODE: add a SetCustomerAsync orchestrator: lookup, then return or update, then create. Only the 'No se encontraron clientes' error may lead to a create; any other lookup error aborts. Move the empty-Partner guard from the controller (:48-59) into the orchestrator.

gaps.rule: storeCode decides the UEN/sales organization by exact match: muebles_america=1, viu=2, mavi=3. Any other value, empty or null makes the call fail.
gaps.lan: LAN CustomerMethods.cs:42-50 (exact, case-sensitive, apostrophes removed); :93 int.Parse(uen) throws on '' -> 500 -> DMZ 400; null storeCode -> NullReferenceException at :43
gaps.ss: BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:407-425 is tolerant: IndexOf('viu') or '2' -> 05; 'muebles_america', '1' or '' -> 04; anything else, including 'mavi', -> 04 fallback. Never fails.
gaps.known_ref: CQ5 (storeCode part unanswered), D-21, T1.1-07, 1.1-R4, RBP-6
gaps.action: Question for the user. LAN CustomerMethods.cs:42-50/:93 maps storeCode exactly and fails on anything else. ServicioSAP BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:411-425 sends 'mavi', unknown values and '' to org 04. Is the 'mavi' store (UEN 3) still live, and which SAP org does it map to? Should an unknown storeCode fail like LAN (through the exception branch, see G01-03) or default to 04? Recommendation: map the three known codes (case-insensitive), make an unknown non-empty value fail like LAN, and keep '' -> 04 until Magento confirms storeCode is always sent (see G01-04). One shared org resolver per SKILL 28, keeping each flow's own default.

gaps.rule: Failure contract: when the customer cannot be registered (exception), Magento gets HTTP 400 with an empty body from the DMZ.
gaps.lan: LAN CustomersController.cs:15-21 has no try -> 500; old DMZ Curl.Post returns e.ToString() containing 'Internal Server Error' -> DMZ CustomersController.cs:34-35 BadRequest()
gaps.ss: BusinessPartnerController.cs:62-65 returns 400 {"Message":"Error, ..."} for SAP HTTP errors, token errors and an invalid idMagento (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:404). DMZ Helper/Curl.cs:130-139 turns that into the text 'WebException: ... (400) Bad Request. Body: ...', which has no 'Internal Server Error', so DMZ CustomersController.cs:37 answers 200 with that text and Magento could store it as the account. The 2xx-without-Partner branch is covered by the accepted CQ6 (d) answer (:48-59).
gaps.action: Question for the user. LAN gave 400 with an empty body (LAN CustomersController.cs:15-21 plus DMZ :34-35). ServicioSAP's exception branch gives Magento 200 'WebException...' (BusinessPartnerController.cs:62-65; DMZ Curl.cs:130-139). Options: A) the catch returns InternalServerError, so the DMZ answers 400 exactly like LAN and the DMZ does not change; B) the catch returns Ok("Error, " + e.Message), consistent with the CQ6 (d) rule; C) leave as is. Recommendation: A for strict parity, or B if Magento already handles the 'Error, ' prefix from CQ6 (d). Never C, because Magento can store the WebException text as the account.

gaps.rule: idMagento and storeCode must be valid, or registration fails. The user's CQ5 answer says Magento always sends idMagento.
gaps.lan: LAN CustomerMethods.cs:74 int.Parse(sntz(idMagento)) and :93 int.Parse(uen) both throw on ''
gaps.ss: BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:401-404 int.Parse(Sntz(idMagento)) throws on '' since S4. Before S4, ParseMagentoId turned '' into 0 and the BP was created (that is how the BP for the CQ10 payload was created).
gaps.action: The anonymized real payload captured for CQ10 (01_CustomersController.md §5) has idMagento "" and storeCode "". LAN would fail with that payload, and ServicioSAP now does too (400, then DMZ 200 'WebException...'). Ask the Magento team to confirm with a fresh capture that setCustomer always carries a numeric idMagento and a storeCode. If it does not, reopen CQ5 before release. Otherwise every such registration fails.

gaps.rule: Copy the CONTADO channel's SeEnviaBuroCreditoMavi (credit bureau) flag onto the new customer.
gaps.lan: SP_eCommerceCtenuevo.sql:88-97 reads it from VentasCanalMAVI (UEN, CONTADO, Clave 'CO%'); :138 writes Cte.SeEnviaBuroCreditoMavi; :157 writes CteEnviarA.SeEnviaBuroCreditoMavi
gaps.ss: MISSING: BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:384-735 sends no equivalent attribute (no Katr1 in the Client model)
gaps.action: Question for the user and SAP SD. What value does the CONTADO row of VentasCanalMAVI hold for SeEnviaBuroCreditoMavi? Does SAP need an equivalent on the BP (e.g. Katr1)? Recommendation: if the CONTADO value is 0/blank, accept the difference and close it. If not, SAP names the field and Client gets it (CODE).

gaps.rule: Names, email, gender and phone are silently truncated to the SP widths (100/100/100, email 100, gender 50, phone 20), so registration never fails because a value is too long.
gaps.ss: BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:394-399 sends full-length values after Sntz/Trim. BP01 may reject names longer than the SAP field (shorter than 100), which ends in the 'Error, <toReturn>' branch (BusinessPartnerController.cs:48-59).
gaps.action: Run the S6 E2E case with a very long name. Then decide: accept the BP01 rejection as the accepted 'Error, <motivo>' answer, or truncate to the BP01 field lengths before sending. Recommendation: accept unless the E2E shows real customers hit it.

processes.what_lan_does: Puts a Magento email on the white or black list (from the Emailage risk check). The SP inserts only if the email belongs to a customer (Cte.eMail1). Black: inserts unless already black, then removes the email from white. White: inserts only if the email is on neither list. It returns an empty string, and the DMZ always answers 'Correcto'.

gaps.rule: The 'email belongs to a customer' check ignores case and trailing spaces (SQL collation, ANSI padding).
gaps.lan: SpVTASListaNBMagento.sql:74-78, :103-107 compare eMail1 = @Correo under the case-insensitive IntelisisTmp collation. LAN also stores eMail1 in UPPER (SP_eCommerceCtenuevo.sql:133).
gaps.ss: CustomerMethods.cs:82-83 builds `Mail eq '<email as sent, URL-encoded>'` against BP05 (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:221). OData eq is probably an exact match. Since S4, setCustomer stores SmtpAddr in UPPERCASE (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:397, :484), while the order flow stores it as typed (OrderMethods.cs:2727). A lowercase email from Magento may therefore no longer match a BP created through setCustomer. ServicioSAP then silently skips the insert, and the DMZ still says 'Correcto' (DMZ CustomersController.cs:74).
gaps.owner: User (+ Diego to run the read-only check)
gaps.action: Step 1, read-only: query BP05 for a BP created after S4 with the email in lowercase and in uppercase (partner/client/filter/Mail eq '...'). Step 2, the user answers CQ14 if the match is case-sensitive. Options: A) ValidarClienteEnSapAsync (CustomerMethods.cs:75-98) tries the email as sent and then ToUpperInvariant(), with Trim(); B) accept the difference. Recommendation: A, because LAN matched regardless of case and S4 just made stored emails uppercase.

gaps.rule: List effects: insert column mapping by position, no duplicate in black, black insert removes the email from white, white insert only if on neither list, column widths, guest values '' kept as ''.

gaps.action: Get sp_helptext SpListaNBMagento and the DDL of ListaNegra/ListaBlanca (types, widths, collation, triggers). Compare them to SpVTASListaNBMagento.sql:71-122, then run the S6 E2E with row counts (T1.2-01). If a rule differs, it becomes a CODE/DATA change in the SIGMavi SP, owned by the DBA.

The old DMZ Curl.Post returned e.ToString(), and the DMZ check `Contains("Internal Server Error")` (DMZ CustomersController.cs:34-35) turned that into BadRequest(). SS BusinessPartnerController.cs:62-65 returns BadRequest("Error, "+e.Message) as 400. DMZ Curl.cs:130-139 turns it into the string 'WebException: The remote server returned an error: (400) Bad Request. Body: {...}', which has no 'Internal Server Error', so DMZ CustomersController.cs:37 returns Ok(text) as 200. The CQ6 answer (01:1349) only chose (d) for the to_return/empty-Partner branch. The text 'las excepciones siguen por el catch actual' records what was implemented, not an acceptance of the WebException-as-200 contract. C-12 is still STILL_OPEN (REVISION:871).

For idMagento, SS now matches LAN: LAN CustomerMethods.cs:74 int.Parse(sntz(idMagento)) and SS BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:401-404 int.Parse(Sntz(idMagento)) both throw on ''. The user explicitly decided this in CQ5 (01:1348: 'if null, or empty, fail like lan because its a required field'). So this is not a parity gap. Only the failure contract differs, and that is G01-03. The CQ10 payload (01:1353) does have idMagento "" and storeCode "". LAN would also have failed on that payload, at :74 and at :93, so it cannot be a LAN-era production call.
verdicts.correction: Reclassify it as a release-risk confirmation, not a parity gap: status EQ_ACCEPTED under CQ5, impact medium, need EXTERNAL (Magento/Omnipro). The only question for Magento is whether the production caller always sends a numeric idMagento. Note that for that payload SS fails only on idMagento: storeCode '' maps to org 04 (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:416), while LAN would also fail on storeCode (CustomerMethods.cs:93).

The builder sends a contact (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:643-668) without setting it. Because the bool is non-nullable and only nulls are skipped (WhenWritingNull, :84-88; RBP-20), ZenviaBuroCred=false always travels.
verdicts.correction: Do not describe it as 'MISSING / no equivalent attribute'. SS always writes ZenviaBuroCred=false on contact 1, type 20 (CteCto.cs:31; BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:643-668). LAN copied the CONTADO channel value onto the customer and the ship-to. Need: DECISION plus EXTERNAL (SAP SD). Is the contact-level ZenviaBuroCred the equivalent of Cte.SeEnviaBuroCreditoMavi, or is there a customer-level field? What value does the CONTADO row hold? If it is 0, the gap closes as EQ_ACCEPTED. Impact low. Keep the known_ref CQ11 / 1.1-R17.

verdicts.evidence: SQL Server silently truncates values passed to the varchar parameters of LAN SP_eCommerceCtenuevo.sql:45-48 (@Apaterno/@Amaterno/@Nombres 100, @SexoCte 50, @CorreoElectronico 100, @TelefonoCTe 20). SS BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:394-399 sends the values at full length. A BP01 rejection ends either in BusinessPartnerController.cs:48-59 ('Error, <motivo>' with 200) or, if BP01 returns HTTP 400, in the catch at :62-65 (G01-03). The SAP person-name fields are usually shorter than 100 (often 40), so names LAN accepted can fail in SS. This should be confirmed in the S6 case.

LAN SpVTASListaNBMagento.sql:74-78 and :103-107 compare cte.eMail1 = @Correo. LAN always stored eMail1 in uppercase (SP_eCommerceCtenuevo.sql:133 on create, :188 on update), so the LAN check only worked because the comparison ignores case. That collation is implied by the code; no file declares it. ANSI trailing-space padding is certain. SS CustomerMethods.cs:82-83 builds `Mail eq '<EscapeDataString(email)>'` against BP05 ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:221) with no Trim and no case normalization. The setCustomer path stores SmtpAddr in uppercase (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:397, :484). The order path stores it as typed (OrderMethods.cs:2727).
verdicts.correction: The risk did not start with S4. It covers every BP whose Mail came from Intelisis, which stored it uppercase, plus every setCustomer BP, against whatever case Magento sends. Trailing spaces are not trimmed (CustomerMethods.cs:82). Keep impact high and need DECISION (CQ14) after the read-only BP05 check. Recommended code if the check is case-sensitive: Trim the email and query as sent, then ToUpperInvariant(), or both in one $filter with 'or'.

Logger.cs:26-31: Directory.Exists/CreateDirectory(<BaseDirectory>\Logs) runs outside any try (the try at :34-41 covers only the write). CashReportMethods.cs:82-83 calls it inside the catch, while LAN CustomerMethods.cs:219-222 does not log. CQ21 is still pending (01:1364).

The same unguarded Logger.SAP runs on the happy path of setCustomer, before and after the BP01 POST (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:89, :100). If <site>\Logs cannot be created, every partner/client call throws, returns 400, and the DMZ answers 200 'WebException...' (G01-03). The same applies inside ValidarClienteEnSapAsync's catch (CustomerMethods.cs:94), where the exception escapes to the setCustomerList catch, which logs again (CustomersController.cs:52) and then returns 500. verdicts.evidence: LAN Conn/Magento.cs:309-317 calls curl.Post, and Helper/Curl.cs:105-107 returns e.Message with 200 when the POST fails. However, LAN Magento's constructor (Conn/Magento.cs:17-19) builds Curl, whose constructor logs in to the DMZ outside any try (Helper/Curl.cs:30-38), so in LAN a login failure is already a 500. SS ConexionDMZ/Curl.cs:122-159 makes 3 attempts with a 2 s/4 s backoff and then throws, and CustomersController.cs:94-98 returns 500.
verdicts.correction: Rule text: in LAN a POST failure, including any DMZ non-2xx, which WebClient raises as a WebException, gives 200 e.Message. A DMZ login failure is 500 in both stacks. Also, SS cancels each attempt after 30 s (Curl.cs:48, :72, :100), while LAN waits up to 9,999,999 ms (Helper/Curl.cs:99), so a slow Magento answer fails in SS and succeeds in LAN. Need: DECISION (CQ24) still applies. Impact medium.

verdicts.evidence: LAN Helper/Curl.cs:94-103 makes a single UploadString with no retry. SS Curl.cs:122-159 makes up to 3 attempts plus one resend on 401 (:133-140), with a 30 s cancellation per attempt (:100), so a slow but successful Magento write can be repeated. The constructor parameter maxRetries exists (Curl.cs:48), so `new Curl(30, 1)` is possible in MagentoAccountMethods.cs:33. CustomersController.cs:104-108 returns 500 on the final failure.

status_corrections.why: The core business behavior differs on real data, not only on a few rules. LAN returns the same account and updates it on every call for a known idMagento: SP_eCommerceCtenuevo.sql:62-68 and :175-206, and per the SP header :35-36 Magento calls this route on account edits. SS creates a new BP on every call (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:435; there is no lookup in BusinessPartnerController.cs:46-60). The exception contract is also wrong: Magento gets 200 with 'WebException...' text that it can store as the account (BusinessPartnerController.cs:62-65 plus DMZ CustomersController.cs:34-37). Both match the DIF definition (wrong data, wrong contract). Only the first-time creation path is equivalent.

Option B: construct Curl with a longer timeout and maxRetries = 1 in MagentoAccountMethods.cs:23 and :33 (for example new Curl(120, 1)), with no change to the shared helper. Recommendation: B for setCuenta (one write, like LAN); A is acceptable for getCuenta until the consumer is known.

compare.summary:
G02 covers the 4 routes in the DMZ ProspectoController and WholesaleCustomerController. None of them is at full parity.
(1) POST prospecto/rfc is MISSING. The DMZ still sends it to LAN (DMZ ProspectoController.cs:23). ServicioSAP has no route and no RFC calculation. Before anyone builds it, D-23 must be decided: LAN commits 2efaf85 and b6cb672 name ticket 10226 "buscar cuenta en app credilana", but Magento also exposes /V1/prospecto/rfc through Mavi_GenerarRFC. Building it also needs D-24, the source of SAT Annexes I-III.
(2) POST prospecto/recuperarcuenta is PARTIAL. It already goes to ServicioSAP (DMZ :42). These rules are equal: removing accents, the {cuenta,nombre,estatus} contract with HTTP always 200, taking the first match, and status 4 when there is no match. These rules differ: only 2 of LAN's 5 required fields are enforced; the name match uses PrimerNombre instead of all given names; the SAP OData filter is case- and space-sensitive while the BP names are stored in uppercase; the filter is not escaped; and the masking algorithm is different and crashes on an empty word. D-25 is still open.
(3) GET company/wholesale-customer is PARTIAL. It already goes to ServicioSAP. Still open: which name to return (D-26), and not-found handling. The catch tests for "404", but the exception message carries "NotFound", so a SAP 404 is probably rethrown as a 500. The DMZ then answers 200 "WebException..." where LAN answered 400 "Customer not found.". That text also ends up in Magento's sales email.
(4) POST company/negotiable-quote/create is a RETIRE_CANDIDATE (D-27 recommends retiring it). It still goes to LAN, which creates a 'Pedido Mayoreo' in VENTA/VentaD. ServicioSAP has no equivalent. Magento ignores the response (NegotiableQuoteManagementPlugin.php:117).
Code has not changed since the 2026-10-05 matrix (§4.1). The S1-S4 uncommitted edits only moved line numbers in BusinessPartnerMethods.cs by about 56 lines. Counts: rules_equal includes accepted differences.

compare.summary:
G03 covers 7 DMZ routes in 3 controllers. Only 2 have a ServicioSAP equivalent, and both are already switched in the DMZ (ConexionSAP 09cb341): POST customer/wallet/details (DMZ WalletCustomerController.cs:38 PostSAP) and POST customer/wallet/getMinimumCostToRedeem (:81 PostSAP). Neither matches LAN, and both are rated DIF.

1) wallet/details has 3 problems:
- It ignores uen (C10) and takes the first SD18 contract, with no active or validity filter.
- It returns CustOwner, a BP code, as titular where LAN returned the customer's name.
- New finding: it serializes with System.Text.Json, which escapes 'ó' as ó. Magento strips every backslash (CustomerWalletManagement.php:131), so the default 'no wallet' message reaches the customer garbled.
- Open: the lookup key (Reference = cliente) and the 'None' sentinel / generate-wallet side effect (D-28) still need SAP SD and the user.

2) getMinimumCostToRedeem does not reproduce LAN's per-family algorithm (C09/D-29):
- No multi-family recompute.
- Family exclusion works differently: exact ContainsKey instead of splitting the comma list.
- A different channel lookup, with an invented fallback.
- Failure is fail-open: no catalog means minimum 0 and full redemption. In LAN the same case ends in 400 at the DMZ and Magento value 0.
- Magento reads only montoMaximoRedimibleGlobal (MonederoManagement.php:447-448), so every deviation changes how much wallet money the customer can redeem.

3) The other 5 routes have no ServicioSAP equivalent and are RETIRE_CANDIDATE, pending a user decision:
- getCuentaC (D-31/P4-Q7): already broken today. The DMZ GETs customer/getCuentaC, while LAN only has POST customer/wallet/getCuentaC.
- status/getStatus (D-30/P5-Q1): an ICMP ping to the Intelisis DB host.
- recommender x3 (D-31/P6-Q1): absent from DMZ origin/Production. No caller of any of these 5 routes was found in Magento248 app/.

No ServicioSAP code for this group changed since the 2026-10-05 matrix. The uncommitted S1-S4 edits do not touch wallet files; the last commits on them are ac9449b and 1f406fb.

To reach LAN parity:
- D-28 Q2-Q5 answered, plus an SD18 capture.
- Then CODE in WalletCustomerController and WalletCustomerMethods: uen/Vkorg filter, active filter, BP name, Newtonsoft serialization.
- D-29 answered (algorithm and failure policy).
- AWS catalog VALOR1..4 semantics and the DM01 status mapping confirmed.
- Then CODE in WalletMethods: per-family algorithm, comma-split families, no fallback, fail-closed.
- D-30 and D-31 decided for the 5 LAN-only routes.

When VENTASCANALMAVI has no matching row or fails to load while the minimum catalogs do load, SS takes the first row of any channel 2/3/6/7, with its minimum and family, possibly 'ALL'. LAN has no fallback: the subquery returns no ID, there are no rows, and the request ends with a NullReference at :273 or :286. Need: DECISION D-29 failure policy. Options: (a) remove the fallback and return 0 when the channel is not found; (b) keep it. Recommendation: (a). Also decide whether a channel with rows in only one of the two minimum catalogs should give 0, as LAN effectively does, or compute the configured bucket, as SS does today.

compare.summary:
G04 covers cash (contado) order creation. DMZ POST order/setOrder (ConexionSAP OrdersController.cs:107-228) sends every order to ServicioSAP POST order/new (PostSAP :196) and passes the JSON back to Magento (:214-227). It no longer calls LAN. Compared: LAN OrdersController.cs:137-161 + Metodos/OrderMethods.cs SetPedido :533-733 (+ crearPedido :1106-1271, DatosEntregaInsert :918-946, GenerarMonedero :1426-1534, afectar :1540-1600, OpenpayMethods.cs, StorePickup/CodigoRecogerSucursal.cs:198-289) against ServicioSAP OrderController.cs:16-48 + Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs SetOrderAsync :1736-1985 (+ BuildSapOrderAsync :2211-2565, partner resolution :2576-2657, BuildBpClientFromOrder :2659-2981, StorePickupMethods.cs:249-319).

Equal today: SKU grouping, saving the original forzarOrder, the PedidoExistente rule (SD36 by PurchNoC replaces Venta by IdEcommerce, and both carry on when the lookup fails), the save-and-exit for openpay_cards, the openpay_stores row, the guide name format, the 200-on-exception policy (decision #4), and the trigger for the bank-transfer pickup code (ported in 61eb2c3).

Main gaps, most severe first:
(1) The response contract differs (R7a-1/C-11/CX-14). LAN answered a bare account string or literal. ServicioSAP answers {BP, SalesDocument, Message, Resultado}, and Resultado is null on success.
(2) openpay_cards orders never reach SAP. There is no `liberado` re-entry and no CheckStatus job (D-38).
(3) Amounts differ. ServicioSAP books `precio`, not `precioEspecial`, and raises prices to the SD29 floor instead of returning PrecioIncorrecto (R7a-4). Shipping, totals, installments, the per-line descuento (Magento coupon discounts) and wallet redemption never reach SAP (R7a-5). ServicioSAP adds a stock gate (R7a-6) and a region rewrite fed with estado (R7a-7), neither of which LAN had.
(4) BP auto-creation. A new BP is created on every order that has `cliente` but no `cuenta`, and before the order POST. The guest BP is hard-coded (R7a-2). openpay_stores without a cuenta is rejected, which LAN never did. BuildBpClientFromOrder applies neither Sntz nor uppercase, unlike setCustomer since the 2026-10-05 session.
(5) Pickup. RegisterPickupClientInfo is a stub that passes the wrong index ([16] = numInt). The bank-transfer code writer takes the name and email from the BP of the SAP order instead of from the pickup person in the order, so guest orders email the generic BP or nobody.
(6) The delivery address is linked with PurchNoS. sap.log (2026-07-17) shows SAP returns PurchNoS "" and the document in to_result.Salesdocument, so the link never happens.
(7) Wallet and the paid-status step (afectar) for PayPal are stubs (R7a-8). Agent Z1 defaults wait on MAVI (R7a-3). ManagePaynetOrders (affect or cancel Paynet orders) has no ServicioSAP equivalent (R7d-4).

Changes since the 2026-10-05 matrix: the order code has not changed. OrderMethods.cs and OrderController.cs were last changed at HEAD 6214ed8, the line references in matrix §4.1 still match (OM:1953-1957, :1962-1975), and the uncommitted S1-S4 edits do not touch these files. Two things are new. First, a divergence: setCustomer now applies Sntz and uppercase (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:391-405, uncommitted) while the order BP builder (OM:2659-2730) does not. Second, item B of runbook §22.7 (pickup code) is now ported (OM:1962-1975), but its data source differs from LAN.

Notes (not parity gaps): the DMZ release, the ServicioSAP→DMZ callback using a hand-built HttpClient that does not renew on 401 (D-39), and the USER_DMZ empty-credential fallback are connection items. LAN's checkOpenpay (LAN OrdersController.cs:446-451) is not exposed by the DMZ, and its caller is unknown (C-15). The credit branch, including the CRED rename UpdateIdEcommerceEnVenta, is in another group. The SP_eCommerceNuevoPed / SPVTASPedidosMagento source is not in the repo, so its rules (guest customer, agent default, price check, casing) are NO EVIDENCE.

results.title: Order creation - credit branch and credit order routes (package 7c / CREDITO)

compare.summary:
G05 covers the credit branch of order/setOrder (which the DMZ sends to ServicioSAP order/new) and the four routes around credit orders. Rule count from today's code (fresh), with user decisions up to 2026-10-05 treated as ground truth: 120 of the vault's 160 credit rules (G1-G5) are closed, meaning equal, equal through a SAP source, an accepted decided difference, or N/A. On 2026-10-02 the count was 119. The +1 is G3-04: the TEL-1 decision (PLAN §27.9) makes A_GET_TelefonoValidado with ZvalTel true the validated phone, so the LAN CteTel rule no longer applies. Per process: the credit branch has 117/150 closed. creditStatus has 0/12 and updateCreditOrderId 0/9, because neither route exists in ServicioSAP. The authorizationResult callback has 5/11 (wrong body keys, and nothing calls it). validateCredit is commented out in the DMZ and nothing calls it, so it is a retire candidate.

The code has not changed since the 2026-10-05 matrix. The credit code is commit 05df55a (inside HEAD 6214ed8). The uncommitted S1-S4 edits touch BP creation and Customer methods, not GetClientAsync, GetClientMaAsync or the credit path. The matrix citations still match: OrderMethods.cs:673-707 for the commented liberador, :1257-1263 for the snake_case payload, :1797-1820 for the credit branch.

What ServicioSAP still needs to reach LAN's credit rules:
1. The liberador trigger plus the Magento callback. This is the critical item: today every credit order gets a request row and 'Concluido', but Magento never receives an authorization. It is blocked by DU11 (Valentín). The code part is T1b, shaped per D-37/LIB-1.
2. Fix the callback body keys and transport (T1a; G5-11, G5-12, CX-17). This is code only, with no external dependency.
3. Port creditStatus (T2a). It is blocked by the decision on where the credit decision comes from (Q-T2-1..3) and on the id type (G5-28).
4. Port updateCreditOrderId (T2b). It is blocked by the SAP OData for ZSDT_VBAK.ZIdEcommerce (DU20).
5. A duplicate guard for the post-authorization resend (T2c-A or T2c-B, D-37).
6. Decide the response contract Magento gets for credit (C-11 / P12 / G5-25).
7. Decide the P1 no-row gates (GATE-1).
8. Line-pricing details: SD29 fan-out (P7/P8b), SEGU00001 float precision (P8d), '05 ... P DIF' conditions (P18), the TELEFONIA swap (Q17, held by the business), and the ZtelCte '+52' format (TQ-3).

Notes that are not parity gaps:
- Order of release: the DMZ ConexionSAP release must not ship the credit branch before T1b (C-02, recommendation C).
- creditStatus and updateCreditOrderId still go through curl.Get/Post to URL_INTELISIS, using the SAP-only token (C-03).
- Magento still sends getCuentaIntelisis() 'C...' accounts (C-09, accepted as transitional). Until that changes, real credit orders end in 'sin cuenta'.
- The checkout gate credit/GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName is not ported (NIP-08). It belongs to the CreditController group, but it blocks end-to-end credit tests.
- Logger CreateDirectory (CQ21) can turn the decided 200 'Error' into a 500 on hosts where the Logs folder is missing.

How rules_equal is counted: EQUAL + EQUAL_SAP_SOURCE + accepted DECIDED_DIFFERENT + N/A. G3-15 and G3-21 (Prospecto via ZtipoCliente) count as closed, as on 2026-10-02, but they still need the user's P16 confirmation.

compare.summary:
G06 covers order cancel/return, store pickup, Openpay/Paynet and the order queries. I read the code on 2026-10-06: DMZ ConexionSAP 09cb341 (clean working tree), LAN stage-delta 68b2290, ServicioSAP SpExportaEcommerce 6214ed8. The uncommitted 10-05 edits (S1-S4) do not touch any order file. OrderController.cs, OrderMethods.cs and StorePickupMethods.cs were last written on 2026-10-02. So the §4.1 rows for this group still hold, with two corrections. First, the returnOrder parity is 'no', not 'partial'. Second, Magento's RMA body never carries store (Omnipro/RmaIntegration/Model/RmaManagement.php:119-150), so every return fails.

Results by status:
- EQ (2): getGuide and GetPickUpCode. Both still need data carried over from LAN, and GetPickUpCode is still routed to LAN.
- DIF (2), both already switched to ServicioSAP:
  - cancelOrder: every Magento cancel answers 400. The three Magento callers send tipo 'T'/'P', and FullCancelAsync (OrderMethods.cs:3010-3011) builds ZSD_T_/ZSD_P_, which SD36 never finds.
  - returnOrder: store is null, so the call throws 'No lleva id de tienda' (OrderMethods.cs:366-368). The DMZ still answers 200 'WebException...' and Magento marks the RMA synced.
- MISSING (3):
  - InsertPaymentData: needs a decision on where Openpay installment payments are written.
  - GetIntelisisStatuses: can be built from SD36 plus billing once the vocabulary mapping is decided.
  - The LAN-only checkOpenpay job.
- BLOCKED on SAP SD/ABAP (3): ManagePaynetOrders, getPosCancellations and estimated-delivery.
- Out of scope: the Magento-direct routes are confirmed out of scope.

What ServicioSAP needs now, in priority order:
1. CODE: fix R7b-1 in FullCancelAsync. Search ZSD_ZMER_ and then ZSD_ZPRE_, and use T/P only as the total/partial flag.
2. DECISIONS D-35 and D-36 (R7b-3, R7b-4, R7b-5, R7b-7, R7b-8), plus a new question about LAN's per-unit service report.
3. EXTERNAL: SAP SD must provide the ZIDSTATUS=03 annulment OData. It is needed to cancel orders with no delivery (LAN's main case) and for Paynet CANCELAR.
4. EXTERNAL: capture one SD09 response for REF_DOC.
5. DECISION: Collections/Diego decide who records and applies Openpay installment payments.
6. CODE: build GetIntelisisStatuses with a CONCLUIDO/CANCELADO mapping.

Notes (deployment, not parity):
- The DMZ Curl constructor now logs in to ServicioSAP and reuses that token for LAN calls (DMZ Helper/Curl.cs:73-85, 'Token = TokenSAP'). Every route here that still goes to LAN depends on LAN accepting that token.
- The cancel SAP calls hard-code Nodos.ENVIROMENT_DEV and sap-client=110 (OrderMethods.cs:3111, :3121, :3148-3149).
- Orders created in Intelisis before the cutover do not exist in SAP. Their cancels answer 'noexiste' (400) and Magento resends them (CustomerCancelOrderObserver.php:130-135).

processes.what_lan_does: Finds the Intelisis Venta by idEcommerce. If there is no invoice, it cancels the whole order with spAfectar VTAS CANCELAR (user FACTU00100). If the order is invoiced, it opens one service report per unit and affects it, and only when resolucion=='R' it creates a return request (SolicitudDevolucion) and affects it. It always answers 200 'Ok', which the DMZ turns into 'Concluido'.

gaps.rule: Find the order to cancel by its ecommerce id, whatever Magento sends in tipo (LAN ignores tipo).
gaps.lan: LAN OrderMethods.cs:1613 looks up venta by idecommerce only; OrdersController.cs:186-250 never reads tipo. Magento sends tipo 'T'/'P' (Omnipro/PlaceOrder/Observer/CustomerCancelOrderObserver.php:78; CustomClearsale/Plugin/UpdateOrderStatusToIntelisis.php:67; Sparsh/SplitOrder/.../SplitOrder.php:573).
gaps.ss: SS OrderMethods.cs:3010-3011 builds PurchNoC = ZSD_{tipo}_{incrementId}, i.e. ZSD_T_/ZSD_P_. SD36 finds nothing, so :3017-3020 returns 'noexiste' and the DMZ turns it into a 400 (DMZ OrdersController.cs:291-292). Every Magento cancel fails.
gaps.action: In FullCancelAsync (OrderMethods.cs:3007-3012), and for consistency in ReverseGoodsIssueAsync :3180-3185 and CancelInvoiceAsync :119-122: treat 'T'/'P' as the total/partial flag, never as a document class. Search ZSD_ZMER_{id} first and then ZSD_ZPRE_{id}, as SalesMethods.cs:216-224 already does. D-35 lists this as a confirmed defect (recommendation 'ZMER plus the flag'); the user only needs to confirm.

gaps.rule: Cancel an order that has not been delivered or invoiced (LAN's most common case).
gaps.lan: LAN OrdersController.cs:200-204 -> OrderMethods.cs:1388-1416: spAfectar VTAS 'CANCELAR' on the Venta.
gaps.ss: SS OrderMethods.cs:3024-3058 throws 'no tiene entrega ... (ZIDSTATUS=03) aun no esta implementada'. The controller answers 400 (OrderController.cs:170-173), the DMZ turns it into 500 (DMZ :294-295), and the order stays alive in SAP.
gaps.action: SAP SD must provide an OData service, with an RSG fiche, that sets ZIDSTATUS=03 (Anulado) on the sales order. Then call it from FullCancelAsync in place of the throw at :3046 and :3057. Until then the explicit failure is correct; do not answer 'ok'.

gaps.rule: Policy for invoiced orders and for partial (tipo P) cancels.
gaps.lan: LAN OrdersController.cs:205-241: never annuls the invoice. It creates a service report per unit (ServiceOrderMethods.cs:82-93, SpINVRepServ), affects it with module ST (:521-593) and logs it with SpVTASEcommerceSolicitudGarantias (:331-335). Only when producto[0].resolucion=='R' does it create a SolicitudDevolucion and affect it with VTAS (OrdersController.cs:215-240).
gaps.ss: SS OrderMethods.cs:3060-3097 annuls the invoice (SD48) and reverses the goods issue (SD46) whenever a delivery exists. It ignores producto, so a partial cancel annuls the whole invoice.
gaps.action: Question for the user, Javier and after-sales. When Magento cancels an order that is already delivered or invoiced (LAN OrdersController.cs:205-241 vs SS OrderMethods.cs:3060-3100), which should ServicioSAP do? (A) LAN policy: never annul; send it to the return flow (order/setreturn ZDME) for the cancelled items. (B) Current behavior: annul the invoice and reverse the goods issue. (C) A for tipo 'P', B for tipo 'T'. Example: an invoiced order with 2 items where 1 is cancelled. LAN creates a report plus a return for that item, and SS annuls the whole invoice. Recommendation: C, because B is wrong for partial cancels.

gaps.lan: LAN OrdersController.cs:202 discards cancelamagento's 'noexiste' (OrderMethods.cs:1385-1386) and answers Ok('Ok') at :249, so Magento always got 200 'Concluido'.
gaps.ss: SS OrderMethods.cs:3020 returns 'noexiste', and DMZ OrdersController.cs:291-292 answers 400 'No existe la orden'. Magento sets synced=0 and resends (CustomerCancelOrderObserver.php:130-135).
gaps.action: Question for the user: (A) keep 'noexiste' as 400, or (B) LAN parity, answer 'ok'. Recommendation: A, but only after G06-01 is fixed. Add a transition rule for orders that exist only in Intelisis (pre-cutover) or never reached SAP (credit, openpay_cards), otherwise Magento keeps retrying them.

gaps.rule: A cancel is reported as successful only when every step succeeded.
gaps.lan: LAN also masked failures: cancelamagento returns the exception text (OrderMethods.cs:1418-1422) and the controller still answers 'Ok' (OrdersController.cs:249). Not a regression.
gaps.ss: SS OrderMethods.cs:3079-3084 swallows a failed SD48 invoice annulment and goes on to SD46, then returns 'ok' while the invoice is still alive.
gaps.action: Swallow the SD48 error only when SAP says the invoice is already cancelled; otherwise rethrow. Apply this together with the G06-03 decision.

gaps.rule: Credit and card orders can be cancelled.
gaps.lan: LAN cancels any Venta found by idecommerce (OrderMethods.cs:1613), including credit and Openpay orders after they were created.
gaps.ss: SS only finds documents created by order/new as ZSD_ZMER_/ZSD_ZPRE_. Credit orders are not posted to SAP by ServicioSAP (OrderMethods.cs:1797-1820, the liberador is commented out), and openpay_cards orders never reach SAP (:1777-1786). Both answer 'noexiste'.

SS OrderMethods.cs:3042-3046 and :3051-3057 throw when there is no delivery. OrderController.cs:170-173 answers 400 'Error, ...'. DMZ Curl.PostSAP (Helper/Curl.cs:130-139) turns the 400 into a 'WebException:' string, which is neither 'noexiste' nor 'ok', so DMZ OrdersController.cs:294-295 answers 500. LAN OrdersController.cs:205-241 never annuls: it runs sendReporte, then afectarReporte ST, and creates the SolicitudDevolucion only when producto[0].resolucion=='R'. SS OrderMethods.cs:3060-3097 annul the invoice (SD48) and reverse the goods issue (SD46), and ignore producto and tipo. Two nuances for the question text. (1) Magento's cancel observer always sends resolucion 'R' (CustomerCancelOrderObserver.php:88, :99), so for an invoiced cancel LAN in practice always created the SolicitudDevolucion. (2) In cancelOrder, estaFacturado fills itemsFactura (ServiceOrderMethods.cs:52-59), so the SolicitudDevolucion copies every invoice line (:441-473). The returned quantities are then set per cancelled SKU through VentaCteDLista (:782-811) and spVentaCteDAceptar (:749-780). SS OrderMethods.cs:3020 returns 'noexiste', and DMZ :291-292 answers 400. Magento sets synced=0 on any non-200 (CustomerCancelOrderObserver.php:130-135). Magento's RMA body has no store (RmaIntegration/Model/RmaManagement.php:119-150, only incrementId, dateTime, producto and tipo). SS BuilAdapterReturn sets storeId = order.store (OrderMethods.cs:2190). BuildSapOrderAsync calls DeterminarPlantYOficina at :2235, which throws 'No lleva id de tienda' (:366-368). The controller answers 400 (OrderController.cs:96-99), PostSAP returns a 'WebException' string (Curl.cs:130-139), the DMZ returns Ok(response) (OrdersController.cs:317-321), and Magento sets synced=1 on 200 (RmaManagement.php:174-176). LAN defaults store='1' (OrdersController.cs:256-259), overrides it from the invoice UEN (ServiceOrderMethods.cs:236, :391-394) and takes Sucursal, EnviarA, Condicion and UEN from the invoice (:362, :413-417). '1'/'2' would map to 04/2000/2000 (:348-351, :381-385), and the channel is '01' (:2228-2230).

SS BuilAdapterReturn maps motivoDevolucion into condicion (OrderMethods.cs:2204). BuildSapOrderAsync takes the first non-empty condicion (:2256-2266) and calls GetCondicionAsync (:2270). That method falls back to PaymentConditionCatalog.GetSapPaymentCode(..., 'ACEF') (:3386; Helpers/PaymentConditionCatalog.cs:122-138), so ACEF overwrites pmnttrms = docOriginal.PaymentCondition (:1654, :2252, :2277). LAN sends @CondicionVenta = the invoice's Condicion (ServiceOrderMethods.cs:388, :417) and puts the reason in @Observaciones (:415) and in the report Concepto (:256). The reason already also goes to Zdescrextra (:2478).

LAN OrdersController.cs:278 checks only producto[0].resolucion=='R'. When it holds, VentaCteDLista is updated for every RMA item (:291-294), and the return covers all items whatever each one's resolution is. SS BuilAdapterReturn (OrderMethods.cs:2196-2207) drops resolucion and creates a ZDME for every RMA.
verdicts.correction: The LAN rule is: the sales return is created only when the FIRST RMA item has resolucion 'R'; in that case all RMA items are returned. LAN has no per-item filter. Mixed RMAs are possible because Magento sends C/R/O per item (RmaManagement.php:133-146). The gap and the need (DECISION, D-36) stand. The question should offer three options: (A) LAN parity, gate on producto[0]; (B) per-item filter on 'R', which improves on LAN; (C) all resolutions, the current behavior. Recommendation B, with the note that it is not strict parity.

verdicts.evidence: SS ProcesarDevolucionSAPAsync sets refDoc = the SD36 sales order number with refDocCat 'C' (OrderMethods.cs:1640, :1652-1653). Items use RefDocIt = the new sequential itmNumber (:2447, :2475), and to_series is empty (:2434). LAN works from the invoiced Venta: Mov Factura/Factura VIU and MovId (ServiceOrderMethods.cs:362, :410-411), with SerieLote in the report (:185-186, :282). Without a real SD09 response, EXTERNAL plus a capture first is the right need.

LAN sendReporte calls insertReporte once per unit for every RMA item, whatever the resolution (ServiceOrderMethods.cs:82-93). insertReporte runs SpINVRepServ 'Reporte Servicio' with branch 41/90, user VENTP01422/VENTP02031, @Rma = rma_item_id and Concepto = reason (:240-307), then guardarSoporte runs SpVTASEcommerceSolicitudGarantias (:331-335; CustomerServiceMethods.cs:117-142). The controller affects each report with ST (OrdersController.cs:274-277). In SS, only the ZDME POST exists (OrderMethods.cs:1681-1733). No service notification or after-sales OData exists anywhere in ServicioSap/Methods.

SS OrderController.cs:213-214 throws HttpResponseException(NotFound) inside the try block. The catch (Exception) at :218-221 catches it and rethrows InternalServerError. LAN OrdersController.cs:174-182 does exactly the same. So in both systems a missing row answers 500, not 404, and the DMZ (OrdersController.cs:238, Json(PostSAP(...))) returns 200 with a 'WebException ... (500)' string.
verdicts.correction: The data gap is real: SS reads its own SQLite servicio_guias (OrderMethods.cs:561-565), and LAN reads C:\inetpub\wwwroot\api\data.db (LAN OrderMethods.cs:758). But the symptom for a pre-cutover order is a 500 from ServicioSAP, and the DMZ wraps it as 200 'WebException...500', not 404. The what_lan_does text of the getGuide process should also say 'not found gives 500 (HttpResponseException caught by the generic catch)' in both systems. Status EQ is unchanged.

verdicts.evidence: The reader parity is EQ: LAN CodigoRecogerSucursal.cs:56-85 vs SS StorePickupMethods.cs:18-40. But the writer side has already moved. DMZ setOrder now posts only to SS order/new (DMZ OrdersController.cs:191-198; the LAN call at :135-183 is commented out). For instore_pickup plus banktransfer orders, SS writes the code to SIGMAVI BpRecogePedidos (OrderMethods.cs:1962-1969 -> StorePickupMethods CreateCodeBankTransferAsync, insert at :292). Meanwhile DMZ GetPickUpCode still reads LAN TrWDM0285_CteRecoge (DMZ OrdersController.cs:262).
verdicts.correction: The action 'switch the reader only together with the writer triggers' is outdated: the order/new writer is already on ServicioSAP. So today, every new pickup order's code is in BpRecogePedidos, while GetPickUpCode looks in TrWDM0285_CteRecoge and finds nothing. The LAN 404 comes back to Magento as a 200 carrying the exception text, because DMZ Curl.Post returns e.ToString() and the route does Json(response). Two things are needed. DATA: copy the open TrWDM0285_CteRecoge rows into BpRecogePedidos. Routing: point DMZ GetPickUpCode at ServicioSAP now, and createStorepickupCode/generateNewStorepickupCode at the same time (CX-12/CX-13). The routing part is a connection item, not a business-rule change. Impact: high for pickup orders created after the order/new switch, medium for old codes.

verdicts.evidence: LAN OrderMethods.cs:44-178. GetOrdersData reads Mov='Pedido' (:136-137). The gate is Estatus=='SINAFECTAR' (:89, :106), with spAfectar VTAS AFECTAR/CANCELAR (:162-178) and the store users at :91 and :108. LAN creates openpay_stores Pedidos unaffected, because only OPENPAY/PAYPAL are affected (LAN OrderMethods.cs:674-676). SS creates the SAP order straight away for openpay_stores (OrderMethods.cs:1788-1792 then continues). No ServicioSAP route, Paynet handler or unpaid-state handling exists, and no annulment API exists (:3036-3046).

LAN OrdersController.cs:54-89 (null -> 400, Importe<=0 -> 400) and OrderMethods.cs:180-222 (INSERT CXCCMensajeWebHookOpenPay with Cobro=0 and IDCXC NULL). Nothing in ServicioSap/Controllers or Methods matches InsertPayment, WebHookOpenPay or openpay apart from the order/new SQLite writes. The only payment-application routes are the Neko stubs (AbonosController.cs:52-84). DECISION is the right need.

LAN OrderMethods.cs:287-336 return every invoice row (Mov LIKE 'Factura%') matched by idEcommerce or ReferenciaOrdenCompra, in raw Intelisis status vocabulary, ordered by Estatus ASC; an error gives empty Data. Magento uses only CONCLUIDO (and needs SucursalOrigen and Importe to be non-null) and CANCELADO, and keys rows by IdEcommerce and by the reference (CheckForInvoices.php:111-132, :155-202). No SS route exists. Omitting other statuses (proposed in the action) is harmless, because Magento ignores them at :155-202.

LAN OrderMethods.cs:224-285: Limit defaults to 200 with a maximum of 1000, Since defaults to now-7d, and the query reads Venta Mov='Pedido', Estatus='CANCELADO', IDEcommerce not empty and not '0', ordered by COALESCE(FechaCancelacion, UltimoCambio). SS SD36 can only filter by PurchNoC (SalesMethods.cs:139-146). No list-by-date OData exists in SS.

LAN EstimatedDeliveryMethods.cs:11-62 (TOP 1 INVDPaqueteriaGuia by the invoice MovId, uppercase values) and :97-128 (EMBCConfiguracionPaqueteria link), with empty strings by default (:13-19). Nothing in ServicioSAP matches paqueteria, rastreo or estimated; Zprerastreo in Response.cs:64 is only a flag. The DMZ checks the format with a numeric regex and answers 400 on 'null' (OrdersController.cs:489-502).

LAN OpenpayMethods.cs:70-101 (poll the processing/charge_pending rows, then SetPedido liberado=true; this includes the split-order rule OrigenIdSplit at :84-99), :103-167 (RECHAZAOPENPAY statuses and 'incomplete' after more than 4 checks) and :271-288. SS OrderMethods.cs:1777-1786 write openpay_orders and return, and nothing reads the table. D-38 is still open.

LAN OpenpayMethods.cs:169-206 cancel the order (cancelamagento) when the Openpay reference is not in_progress or completed and the Venta is still sinafectar, then set Magento to 'canceled_intelisis'. SS writes openpay_stores (OrderMethods.cs:498-522) and keeps the SAP order alive (:1788-1792), and no job reads the table. This depends on R7b-2.

gap.rule: A cancel that answers 'ok' must leave the order cancelled. LAN closes the document with CANCELAR whenever the order is not invoiced.
gap.lan: LAN OrdersController.cs:200-204 -> OrderMethods.cs:1388-1416: when estaFacturado is false (ServiceOrderMethods.cs:34-36, Mov 'factura'/'factura viu'), spAfectar VTAS 'CANCELAR' Base 'Todo' cancels the whole Venta.
gap.ss: SS FullCancelAsync, when a delivery exists but there is no billing document (OrderMethods.cs:3060-3072 skip SD48), only calls ReverseGoodsIssue (SD46, :3088-3090, :3109-3144) and then returns 'ok' (:3100), and the DMZ answers 200 'Concluido' (DMZ OrdersController.cs:297). The outbound delivery is not deleted and the sales order is not rejected or annulled (ZIDSTATUS=03), so SAP can deliver and bill the order again while Magento shows it cancelled. The same holds after SD48+SD46 for an invoiced order (the order and the delivery stay open).
gap.action: SAP SD: confirm what a full cancellation means in S/4 for a delivered order. The usual sequence is reverse goods issue, then delete the outbound delivery (API_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY_SRV DELETE A_OutbDeliveryHeader), then reject or annul the sales order (the ZIDSTATUS=03 annulment API from R7b-2). CODE in ServicioSAP once confirmed: after PostReverseGoodsIssueAsync, delete the delivery and call the annulment API before returning 'ok'. Until then, return an explicit error, as already done for the no-delivery case (:3042-3057), so that Magento retries instead of marking the order cancelled.
gap.known_ref: R7b-2, D-35 (extends R7b-2 to the delivered/not-invoiced case)

gap.rule: Each Magento RMA creates its own traceable after-sales documents, carrying the RMA item id.
gap.lan: LAN insertReporte passes @Rma = rma_item_id and @IdPedidoEcommerce for every unit (ServiceOrderMethods.cs:304-305). Each RMA call creates its own report(s) and its own SolicitudDevolucion (:404-430), so a second RMA on the same order creates new, distinct documents.
gap.ss: SS ZDME uses PurchNoC = ZSD_ZDME_{incrementId} (OrderMethods.cs:2320 with docType ZDME at :2214-2216), the same value for every RMA of an order. rma_item_id (Models/SAP/Order/OrderRequest.cs:77) is not mapped in BuilAdapterReturn (OrderMethods.cs:2196-2207), and the return path skips any duplicate check (SetOrderAsync :1740-1743). A second RMA for the same order produces a ZDME that cannot be told apart from the first, and nothing links either ZDME to its Magento RMA.
gap.action: Question for the user and Marcos: how should a ZDME be tied to its Magento RMA (LAN ServiceOrderMethods.cs:304 vs SS OrderMethods.cs:2320, :2196-2207)? (A) Put the RMA id in PurchNoC, e.g. ZSD_ZDME_{incrementId}_{rmaId}. (B) Keep the PurchNoC and carry rma_item_id in a Z field or item text (Zdescrextra/ZOBS). (C) Leave it as is. Example: order 2000012345 with RMA 1 (sofa) and RMA 2 (chair) gives two ZDMEs, both ZSD_ZDME_2000012345. Recommendation: B, because it needs no SAP change. Check with SAP that duplicate PurchNoC values are allowed.

gap.rule: For an in-store pickup order, the pickup contact row (name, email, phone) is registered when the order is created; the code generators and emails later read it.
gap.lan: LAN SetPedido calls setNameToReference for metodoEnvio 'instore_pickup' (OrderMethods.cs:657-660). It runs SpWDM0285_CteRecoge (:1273-1311), which inserts IdEcommerce, Nombre, Correo, Telefono and ClaveVenta='' into TrWDM0285_CteRecoge.
gap.ss: SS RegisterPickupClientInfo (OrderMethods.cs:1572-1586) only writes to the console, and it receives sDatosPedido[16] as the email (:1931). Only the banktransfer path writes BpRecogePedidos at order creation (:1962-1969). For other payment methods, the contact row exists only after Magento calls createStorepickupCode, and its Nombre and Correo come from that path, not from the order's NombreClienteMavi and correo.
gap.action: In RegisterPickupClientInfo, insert or update BpRecogePedidos (IdEcommerce, Nombre=NombreClienteMavi, Correo=the order's email index, not [16], Telefono, ClaveVenta='') using the StorePickupMethods writers. Alternatively, record in the vault that the createStorepickupCode insert branch is the intended single writer. This is already tracked as D-03/D-12 in COMPARATIVA_SETORDER_LAN_VS_SAP.md:53, :73, :82, and belongs to the order/new package. It is listed here only because it feeds the pickup data that GetPickUpCode reads.

compare.summary:
G07 compares the 10 routes in its list plus the other 16 routes of DMZ Controllers\CustomerServiceController.cs (26 in total). Code read on 2026-10-06: DMZ ConexionSAP 09cb341, LAN stage-delta, ServicioSAP 6214ed8 plus the working copy. None of the 10 G07 routes behaves differently since the 2026-10-05 matrix. The uncommitted edits touched only CreateClient/BuildClient code in BusinessPartnerController.cs and BusinessPartnerMethods.cs, which moved line numbers: unircuenta is now at BusinessPartnerController.cs:90-108, successfactor at :181-194, GetClientMaAsync at BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:266-309 and LinkMagentoAccountAsync at :779-819. ServicioSAP CustomerServiceController.cs and CustomerServiceMethods.cs have not changed since 17/09.

Status of the 10 G07 routes:
- EQ (1): obtenerQuejas.
- PARTIAL (4): unirCuenta, validarCliente, LoginClienteCredito, LoginClienteCreditoFechaN. All four are already bridged by the DMZ to ServicioSAP.
- MISSING (4): obtenerVentanaConfirmacion, nombreCliente, bitacoraAtencionClientes, GetEmpleadoByNomina. The DMZ still sends these to LAN.
- BLOCKED (1): obtenerTipoGarantia, waiting on the Dev 3 / Valentin-Humberto warranty table.

Rule counts for the 10 G07 routes: 78 rules compared, 33 equal.

Most important gaps, in order:
1. LoginClienteCreditoFechaN: customers born before 1970 cannot log in. The regex '\d+' at CustomerServiceMethods.cs:282 drops the minus sign of '/Date(-ms)/'. This is a code fix (R8-04).
2. Logins: the email Magento uses as the BBVA payer email comes from the first to_CtePersonalAdr.smtp_addr instead of Cte.eMail1 (R8-01, needs an E2E).
3. Logins and validarCliente: any SAP failure answers 200 false, so it looks like 'account does not exist'. LAN answered 500 (R8-02, D-40/D-43).
4. validarCliente: '0' matches every BP with ZidMagento=0, and nombres carries only NameFirst (R8-22).
5. Four routes have no ServicioSAP code. nombreCliente and obtenerVentanaConfirmacion can reuse existing pieces: GetClientMaAsync, ocultarLetrasNombres, GetTelefonoValidadoAsync, and SD36 CheckDocumentExistsSD36Async. bitacoraAtencionClientes can call SP_ACTES_REGISTRO through obtenerConexionAndroidAsync, but that SP also inserts into ERPMAVI.IntelisisTMP RM1138PendientesxValidar, which needs a decision. GetEmpleadoByNomina can reuse the SuccessFactors call and the 'Codigo de promotor' catalog check (OrderMethods.cs:1040-1055), but first the user must decide whether seller registration is retired.

Extra routes of the same controller: these were checked at route level, and their full rule-by-rule comparison belongs to the 8b/8c owners.
- obtenerCreditos: PARTIAL (D-42).
- GetAccountDebts: DIF (R8-21).
- Neko trio: OUT_OF_SCOPE (stubs AbonoMethods.cs:95-104; do not connect, D-41).
- ApplyPaymentAdvanced, UpdateStatusPaymentAdvanced, GetSTPAccount, ObtenerEstatusEmbarque: BLOCKED on ABAP (Dev 4).
- GetSalesChannelsSTP, ValidateSTPAccount, validarCoberturaPorCP: MISSING.
- bbvaKeyAdvanced: EQ.
- Tablerate trio: RETIRE_CANDIDATE (R8-18; no LAN route).

Notes, not gaps:
- PATCH unircuenta and its CSRF call send no sap-client (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:786-787).
- Releasing the DMZ is a deployment step.
- The Intelisis 'C...' account that Magento may send in cliente, id_cliente_intelisis and ClientNumber is the accepted transitional difference (CX-07).

No files were changed, no SQL was run and no endpoint was called.

compare.summary:
Package 8b (CustomerService: BBVA, STP and Neko payments, plus debts), checked against the code on 2026-10-06. The code for these routes has not changed since the 2026-10-05 matrix (§4.1). ServicioSAP has no uncommitted edits in AbonosController, AbonoMethods or CustomerService*, the DMZ is still at 09cb341, and every line reference in §4.1 rows 129-140 still holds. Only one route has full parity: bbvaKeyAdvanced (EQ, 7/7 rules, already bridged with DMZ :289 GetSAP).

The most urgent gap is GetAccountDebts. It is live on ServicioSAP (DMZ :146 PostSAP) but still DIF (1/14 rules). Today it returns the raw rows of the EX01 service as a flat array. LAN instead returns {data:{<channel>:{nombre,facturas[]}},status} with: debts grouped by CanalVenta; one entry per invoice, the earliest due installment; the summed installment amount and late interest; the DIMAS on-time-payment rule; the late-interest collection policy (SpCXCCalcAbonoCobXPol); rounding up to whole pesos plus the 1-peso equalization; the Vencido (overdue) flag; and the PENDIENTE status taken from CXCCFacturaMultipagoBBVA. ServicioSAP also ignores StoreId/UEN and does not exclude Contable=1 rows. Because Magento builds the debts it sends to ApplyPaymentAdvanced and GetSTPAccount from this response, the broken shape probably also breaks those LAN routes (int.Parse(debt["CanalVenta"])), but this is inferred, not verified in Magento code.

Status of the other routes:
- Blocked on Dev 4, ABAP and SAP FI: ApplyPaymentAdvanced and GetSTPAccount (R8-08, nowhere in SAP to write the payment intent), and UpdateStatusPaymentAdvanced (R8-09, nowhere to write the confirmation).
- Buildable once read-only definitions are settled: ValidateSTPAccount (needs R8-10 row selection; the GetClabeSTP reader exists) and GetSalesChannelsSTP (needs R8-11 legacy channel-id mapping; the SD52 reader exists at partner/ventadist).
- Neko trio (ApplyPaymentNeko, UpdateStatusPaymentNeko, bbvaKeyNeko) is RETIRE_CANDIDATE pending R8-07/CX-25/D-41. The ServicioSAP stubs (credit/ prefix, always 200 {Success:true}) must never be connected; status only.

Not included here: LoginClienteCredito and LoginClienteCreditoFechaN are in the same DMZ 'Multipagos' region (:213-232) but belong to package 8a. The other CustomerService routes belong to 8a and 8c. No secrets are reproduced: CODIGO_ENT and MULTIPAGOS_APIKEY_URL exist in SS Web.config:79-80.

compare.summary:
G09 covers 6 DMZ routes. All of them still go to LAN today: DMZ CustomerServiceController.cs:118, :310, :326, :342, :354 and :366 all use curl.Post.

- **obtenerCreditos (PARTIAL).** A ServicioSAP route exists (SS CustomerServiceController.cs:117-141 -> CustomerServiceMethods.cs:327-531, SD36 ZAPI_DOCVTAS_CHECK + BP05MA + DM01). 9 of 20 LAN rules are equal. Already tracked as open: estatus (R8-12), the uen filter (R8-13) and id/fecha/order/rounding/Descuento (R8-14). New finding: ServicioSAP only sees credits that already exist as SAP sales documents. The credit branch of order/new writes no SAP document (OrderMethods.cs:1797-1820, comment "Credito no va a SAP aqui" at :1819). LAN listed every 'solicitud credito' from the moment it was created (LAN CustomerServiceMethods.cs:559). Pending and rejected applications are therefore invisible in ServicioSAP. Errors are also swallowed into a 200 "" response, and a debug line writes customer data to disk (SalesMethods.cs:200).
- **validarCoberturaPorCP (MISSING).** There is no ServicioSAP route. The internal GET sepomex/validarcp (SepomexController.cs:12-27) is a generic OData passthrough with no equivalent of MaviRutaSupervision, so it cannot express coverage. The business must name the coverage source first (R8-16, D-44).
- **ObtenerEstatusEmbarque (BLOCKED).** SAP has no Embarque/EmbarqueMov equivalent; this waits on ABAP and logistics (R8-EMB). Partial building blocks exist: SD36 lookup by eCommerce id (SalesMethods.cs:216) and A_OutbDeliveryItem (OrderMethods.cs:3196-3299).

compare.summary:
G10 covers 10 CreditController routes in package 9a. Today 9 of them still go to LAN (DMZ CreditController.cs:76, :107, :135, :193, :206, :279, :296, :376, :388). Only SendSmsNewNumber goes to ServicioSAP (PostSAP, :308). The DMZ is unchanged at 09cb341, and commit 97d6aea (the E-45 cutover) is still not in the clone.

ServicioSAP has 4 of the 10 routes: getSms, validateSms, codigoPromocion and SendSmsNewNumber (SS Controllers\CreditController.cs:15-87). Their business rules are close to LAN:
- **validateSms:** equal to LAN apart from accepted differences. The SP's CODIGO branch is copied into C#: same parameter widths, 5/6, no expiry check.
- **getSms:** every LAN branch is ported (new code, status 1/2/3 resend, queue row 23/DM0363, codes 3/0/-1/err). It still has one open business difference: a failed ZidMagento PATCH returns -1 and stops the SMS (D-47/NIP-1). That PATCH URL still lacks sap-client=110 (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:786-787). It also depends on two outside checks: whether the SMS dispatcher sends BP-keyed rows (CX-11), and the ZtelCte format (TQ-3).
- **SendSmsNewNumber:** equal except one low-impact error path (an empty idRef).
- **codigoPromocion:** built and close to LAN. Still pending:
  - the keep-or-retire decision (D-45 vs DU16);
  - two accepted-or-decide details (D-46: 500 for an unknown opcion, Centro NULL on the renewed coupon);
  - one new finding: the legacy SpVTASVentaCupon ValidarCupon also accepts an active employee's payroll number when the department and position are in TablaStD 'Código de promotor', and auto-creates the coupon (SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:74-110). The SIGMAVI SpVentasCupones body is not on the share, so this rule has NO EVIDENCE on the ServicioSAP side.

**Missing routes:**
- **GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName** (the credit checkout gate, R9-14/TQ-8/D-48) is the critical one. Without it, getSms and validateSms cannot be switched for BP customers. It needs a code port plus 3 source decisions: employee exclusion, CREDITO MENUDEO channel eligibility, first purchase. The phone part (A_GET_TelefonoValidado) and the origin catalog are already available in SS.
- **getCreditAccount** is missing (D-51/R9-13). Its only caller is a Magento cron that sends a 'Credilana Nuevo Funnel' analytics event, so scope must be confirmed first.
- **Validar_Lada, ExistRFCAndPhoneCte, codigoRecomendado, codigoRecomendadoWithUen** are retire candidates (D-31/R9-11/CX-26). ExistRFCAndPhoneCte returns a constant in LAN. The other callers are only Credilana (CreditMigration) and ProductosMX (deferred). No Magento caller of Validar_Lada was found.

**Changes since the 2026-10-05 matrix:**
- No SS code change on these routes. Line numbers in CreditController and CreditMethods still match.
- LinkMagentoAccountAsync moved from BPM:835-875 to :779-819 in the uncommitted S1-S4 diff. Its logic is unchanged, and it still has no sap-client.
- The matrix row for codigoPromocion still lists the 'Elimina returns empty' divergence. That is parity: both SPs chain NUEVO, which ends in SELECT @Agente.

**Not added here:** the other DMZ CreditController routes (getClienteSaldo, getClienteFactura, CreditoWeb_*, SaveImagesProductosMx, Monedero/Unification, SaveHaztenTransaction, SolicitudMercancia, GetCreditAmounts, getPlazos, guardardocumento) belong to the other package-9 groups (balances, documents, Credilana, Mercancías), so they are not repeated here.

**Notes, not parity gaps:**
- The switch of the 3 SMS/coupon routes is C-14 (flip DMZ :76, :107 and the gate route together with the Magento BP release).
- Carts still open at the switch keep codes keyed by the C account and need a resend.

results.title: Credit - balances, invoices, wallet unification, amounts, terms, documents (package 9b)

compare.summary:
G11 (package 9b, credit balances, invoices, wallet, amounts, terms, documents). I compared 11 processes against the code as it is on 2026-10-06. None of the G11 files changed since the 2026-10-05 matrix. git status shows uncommitted edits only in BP/Customer files. The last commits touching ServicioSAP CreditController/AbonosController/AbonoMethods/DocumentMethods/CreditMethods/CredilanaMethods predate 6214ed8, so every §4.1 row for this group still holds.

Where each route stands:
- **Switched to ServicioSAP, same rules except accepted differences (EQ_ACCEPTED):**
  - guardardocumento: 8 of 9 rules equal. The only difference is the client-key test: '15' prefix and length 10 or less, versus LAN 'C'/'P' prefix and length 11 or less (CX-07).
  - SaveImagesProductosMx: 7 of 8 equal. Only the image folder differs, and it is configurable.
- **Switched but partial:**
  - getPlazos: 4 of 6 equal. Open points are the error body (D-46) and the static-catalog key mapping.
  - GetCreditAmounts: 7 of 8 equal. The code matches LAN, but its SQLite cache mavi_credilana_info is filled by nobody in ServicioSAP, so every call returns 500. Open: D-49 (is this Credilana?) and R9-04 (who fills the cache).
- **Switched but wrong (DIF):** getClienteFactura, 0 of 9 equal.
  - ServicioSAP returns a list of TZ01 zsplits instead of LAN's SaldoFactura object, so the DMZ's JObject.Parse turns every call into a 500.
  - It also ignores the {cliente} segment. Any invoice number returns its installments regardless of the customer (new finding).
- **Not built, waiting on a decision (MISSING):** MonederoSaldoCredito (R9-08). The SD18 wallet wrapper used by customer/wallet/details could serve it.
- **Blocked by other teams:**
  - getClienteSaldo: needs the N1/N2 SAP captures and decisions N4-N16 (R9-06/R9-07/D-52).
  - The three wallet-unification routes: need a home for CREDIHUnificacionMonedero and the process that completes unifications (Valentín / Dev 2 / ABAP), plus the business call on the contradictory category rule (R9-09).
- **Out of scope:** the LAN-only filler credit/SaveCredilanaInfo (Credilana, user decision). It is listed only because GetCreditAmounts depends on it.

The other 21 routes of DMZ CreditController (getSms, validateSms, codigoPromocion, CreditoWeb_*, codigoRecomendado*, SaveHaztenTransaction, getCreditAccount, GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName, SendSmsNewNumber, SolicitudMercancia, Validar_Lada, ExistRFCAndPhoneCte) are in the 9a / 9-remaining / Credilana groups and are not repeated here.

Notes outside parity:
- guardardocumento is [AllowAnonymous] on the DMZ (R9-05/CX-21). Not counted as a parity gap.
- getClienteSaldo still calls LAN, and LAN's regex rejects numeric BPs, so Magento gets 400 'No existe el cliente' today.
- The DMZ wraps GetCreditAmounts/Monedero/unification responses as text after Trim('"'). It does this for both backends, so this is not a difference.

compare.summary:
G12 parity on 2026-10-06. I checked the code read-only: no edits, no SQL, no HTTP calls.

**Where the routes go today.** All 10 G12 routes still go from the DMZ to LAN via curl.Post (DMZ CreditController.cs:149, :164, :178, :268, :325, :340, :364, :399, :411, :423; branch ConexionSAP 09cb341). ServicioSAP has none of them:
- Its CreditController.cs only has SendSmsNewNumber, codigoPromocion, getSms, validateSms, getPlazos, GetCreditAmounts, guardardocumento, SaveImagesProductosMx and condicionespago.
- `git log --all -S` finds no SaveHaztenTransaction or SolicitudMercancia in any ServicioSAP ref, and this clone has no stash.
- The uncommitted 2026-10-05 S1-S4 edits do not touch credit.

So **nothing in the code changed since the 2026-10-05 matrix**. What is new is evidence about who calls each route (Magento app/code/Mavi). That evidence settles most of R9-10, R9-12 and R9-15.

**Out of scope (5 routes):**
- **CreditoWeb_Seguro:** written exclusion, GUIA §1.6b:213.
- **CreditoWeb_Informacion, CreditoWeb_Solicitud, CreditoWeb_SolicitudPrimerGuardado:** they run SPCREDICredilana (LAN CreditMethods.cs:1206, :1294, :1347), which the same exclusion names.
  - The DMZ groups them under `#region CREDILANA` (:332-428).
  - Their only Magento callers are the CreditMigration Credilana flows: existing-client loan (ClientCreditManagement.php) and life insurance (SegurosDeVidaManagement.php). That module's admin group is labelled 'CrediLana y Prestamo Personal'.
- **SolicitudMercancia:** writes origen 'APP MERCANCIAS' and IdMagento 'APP MERCANCIA' (LAN CreditMethods.cs:609-673). No Magento module calls it, so it belongs to the APP mercancías project (GUIA §1.6b:199). R9-12 should close as option A, and Dev 3 should be told to stop E-44.

**Missing in ServicioSAP; they need a scope decision first (5 routes):**
- **CreditoWeb_SaveFirstData:** callers are ProductosMX CreditMxManagement.php and CreditMigration CredilanaManagement.php (origen CREDILANA MX or APERTURA CUENTA).
- **CreditoWeb_SaveData_Articulos:** only caller is ProductosMX CreditMxManagement.php:465/:513.
- **CreditoWeb_FormDatos:** callers are CreditMigration and ProductosMX FormInformation.php.
- **CreditoWeb_SaveData:** only caller is CredilanaManagement.php:510/:572/:716/:778, for Credilana and for account opening without merchandise.
- **SaveHaztenTransaction:** Magento creates Hazten transactions only in CredilanaManagement.php:575 and CreditMxManagement.php:525, never in the normal checkout.

**The order/new note is imprecise.** The 'CreditoWeb_SaveData @Op=Insert lives in order/new' note does not hold:
- ServicioSAP order/new (OrderMethods.cs:634-793 plus SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:18-308) ports LAN SetOrder's ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (LAN CreditMethods.cs:94, called from OrderMethods.cs:624).
- It requires an existing BP: `throw "sin cuenta"` at OrderMethods.cs:640-643.
- It does not cover what this route does: generate a prospect account, strip accents, insert references, run the Update op, or return "id/cliente".

**Reusable pieces if the scope is opened:**
- SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.InsertAsync
- OrderMethods.InsertCreditArticlesAsync (SD29 price by SKU, SEGU00001 rule)
- credit/codigoPromocion
- sepomex/validarcp (for GET_CP)
- CredilanaMethods.GetCredilanaInfoAsync (but mavi_credilana_info still has no owner)

**Counts:** 34 LAN rules compared, 0 equal.

**What is needed now, in order:**
1. A user decision on R9-10/CX-27 for 'APERTURA CUENTA': is account opening part of the Credilana exclusion? Its amounts already come from SAP (GetCreditAmounts montos_cte_nuevo_apertura), while the rest of the flow stays on LAN.
2. Confirm R9-15 (ProductosMX deferred to Feb-Mar 2027). SaveHaztenTransaction's scope follows these two decisions, because it has no caller outside those flows.
3. Close R9-12 as A.
4. Only if a route is brought in scope, the CODE/DATA items listed per process:
   - the prospect BP that replaces SP_GeneraConsecutivoCteMavi
   - the references table
   - the SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS Update branch (excluded by the 2026-09-24 Insert-only decision)
   - the ServicioAndroid PrimerGuardado ops with the NIP SMS
   - checking that the SIGMAVI biometric tables exist
   - a target for RM0855ACoordenadasProspecto

**Other CreditController routes** (getSms, codigoPromocion, GetCreditAmounts, SaveImagesProductosMx, wallet, getCreditAccount and others) are not in the G12 list. I assume sibling groups cover them.

compare.summary:
G13 has 28 DMZ routes: 8 product/*, 13 magento/*, 5 mercancias/*, login/authenticate and logging. Every one of them is out of scope or a retire candidate, and none of them hides a Magento-facing business rule that ServicioSAP must answer.
- product/* (DMZ ProductsController.cs:25-123): 5 routes call Magento, 1 writes to the DMZ's local disk, 1 uploads by SFTP and getStockByStore is a stub.
- magento/* (MagentoController.cs:13-127): straight Magento REST calls.
- mercancias/* (MercanciaController.cs:15-97): still forwards to LAN through new Curl().Post.
- login/authenticate and logging: DMZ-local.

The real parity work is in the ServicioSAP callers that replace LAN's internal catalog jobs: CatalogController plus MagentoCatalogMethods, i.e. E-16..E-24 (replacing the Magento-preload half of LAN product/updateProduct, updateConfigurableProduct and updateStock), and E-11/E-12 (customer/getCuenta and setCuenta).

The step-by-step SQLite loads are faithful ports of LAN stage-delta Conn/Magento.cs:22-359 (same URLs, cleanup, delete+reseq, inserts, page size and stop condition). The gaps are around those loads:
- E-22 follows stage-delta, not LAN Production. It has no null guards and no per-SKU second pass, and it calls a 2-segment DMZ template that the Production DMZ does not expose (D-54, D-07, C-01).
- The E-19 leg that writes Intelisis/MySQL is not ported: atributosdemagento / atribmgtovalorlista and SpWDM0285_AtributosdeMagento 'ActAtrib'.
- ServicioSAP writes to its own SQLite file (C:\inetpub\wwwroot\sap\data.db), which nothing in ServicioSAP reads. LAN wrote to the file the importer reads (C:\inetpub\wwwroot\api\data.db).
- No scheduler or caller and no sequencing. LAN chained deletePromociones, deleteReservations and children inside the importer and stock jobs (C-16).
- The DMZ Curl retries 3 times with a 300 s timeout on deletePromociones, which writes to Magento and can run long. LAN made one call with no practical timeout.
- E-11/E-12 differ from LAN only in the error branch. That is already tracked in package 1 (CQ24 / T1.C-01, caller unknown CQ23 / C-15).

Changes since the 2026-10-05 matrix (§4.1): none in business code. The only change is in MagentoAccountMethods.cs:25 and :35, which add ConfigureAwait(false) (uncommitted S1-S4). E-22 still calls '/{page}/1000' (MagentoCatalogMethods.cs:325).

Connection notes (not parity gaps):
- ServicioSAP Curl sends 'Bearer <token>'; LAN sends the raw token.
- The DMZ JWT keys must match per environment (C-03).
- login/authenticate needs USER/PASS hash and salt in the DMZ Web.config (C-04).
- logging's API key is hard-coded in LogService/Filters.cs.
- mercancias depends on the DMZ Curl login to ServicioSAP (C-03).

Watch item, out of this group: Magento consumes the products array only for status store_pickup_complete, and its emitter is outside LAN, DMZ and ServicioSAP (BAJA_getOrderId.md §7).

DMZ ConexionSAP MagentoController.cs:69-75 exposes only '{page}/{size}'. DMZ origin/Production exposes only '{page}/{size}/{sku}' (DMZ Production Conn getProductWithWebsites maps '$$8' to '%2B'). The gap matches D-54 (REVISION_PLAN...:738-746).
verdicts.correction: Keep the gap and the DECISION, with three corrections. (1) The owner in D-54 is Diego (the E-22 owner) + the DMZ owner, not a generic 'Dev 2'. (2) Option A cannot be fully ported on its own. The per-SKU pass reads the importer's 'products' table (LAN Production Conn/Magento.cs:362; it is filled by pm.DeleteProducts/exporta_art), and no ServicioSAP code creates or reads a 'products' table (grep 'FROM products|INTO products' returns zero). The null guards and the URL/page-size change can be done now. (3) Impact: against the Production DMZ, the 2-segment call returns 404 and every cargaCompleta answers 500 (D-54 example). verdicts.evidence: LAN Helper/Curl.cs:130-133 returns e.ToString() on a failed GET. Deserializing that text throws, and ProductsController.cs:111-115 answers 200 'Ocurrio un error: ...'. WebClient timeout is 9999999 ms (Curl.cs:121). SS MagentoCatalogMethods.cs:21 sets new Curl(timeoutSeconds: 300). Curl.cs:122-159 makes 3 attempts and then throws, and CatalogController.cs:28-32 answers 500. Earlier steps stay written, because each step clears and refills its own table. LAN Helper/Curl.cs:125-127 decodes UTF-8 and applies Normalize(FormC) to the raw DMZ text before any JSON parsing. SS Curl.cs:142 uses ReadAsStringAsync. But the text that reaches both is the DMZ's JSON string around Magento's REST body (DMZ Conn/Magento.cs:48-58, MagentoController.cs:13-51 Ok(string)), and Magento escapes non-ASCII characters as \uXXXX. LAN's own explicit Replace(@"\\u00e1", ...) chains (LAN Magento.cs:35-48, :93-106, :132-145, :223-236), which SS reproduces in NormalizarAcentos (:350-367), only work because of that escaping. FormC on pure-ASCII escaped text is the identity, and it never touches the labels decoded later by JsonConvert.
verdicts.correction: Lower the impact to 'low, probably no functional effect' and mark the CODE change optional. FormC would change the result only if Magento returned raw (unescaped) combining sequences, which the LAN escape handling contradicts. If it is kept, also apply it to E-21/E-22 (LAN normalizes every Curl.Get, including children and productWithWebsites). Do not let it block package 11.
