gap.lan: LAN origin/Production Conn/Magento.cs:185-214 wraps each set in try/catch with Logger.intelisis and continues, then runs am.sendIntelisis() at :217. LAN stage-delta Conn/Magento.cs:184-212 has no per-set try (git diff stage-delta..origin/Production).
gap.ss: MagentoCatalogMethods.cs:177-203 has no per-set try. A failure in _curl.GetAsync (:179), in response.Remove (:181-182) or in Deserializar (:187-188, rethrows at :40) aborts the method. atributos_de_magento is left partly filled, and CargaCompleta (CatalogController.cs:28-32) and catalog/attributeSetChildren (:124-128) answer 500. This matches the unresolved E-19 failure of 2026-09-15.
gap.action: Question (D-07): for E-19, is LAN origin/Production (per-set try/catch, Conn/Magento.cs:185-214) or stage-delta (abort on first failure, :184-212) the reference? Options: A) Production: wrap the body of the foreach at MagentoCatalogMethods.cs:177-203 in try/catch that logs (Logger.SAP) and continues; B) stage-delta: keep it as is. Recommendation: A. It is what runs in production today, and it keeps one bad set from blanking the whole attribute catalog.

gap.rule: Page size used when loading child products (visibility=1) per store
gap.lan: LAN origin/Production Conn/Magento.cs:270 uses 'magento/children/'+page+'/500/'+store. LAN stage-delta Conn/Magento.cs:267 uses '/1000/'.
gap.ss: MagentoCatalogMethods.cs:286 uses '/1000/' (stage-delta). The result's claim 'page size 1000 (LAN :267 = ServicioSAP :286)' holds only for stage-delta.
gap.action: Decide this together with D-07/D-54. If Production is the reference, change MagentoCatalogMethods.cs:286 to '/500/' (the same move as E-22's 500 page size), probably because Magento timed out or ran out of memory at 1000. Otherwise record 1000 as accepted.

gap.rule: The SQLite file the catalog preload writes to must contain the catalog schema: attribute_options, attributes, attribute_sets, categories, atributos_de_magento, children and product_in_stores, with AUTOINCREMENT ids and sqlite_sequence
gap.lan: LAN DB.cs:17 writes to the importer's existing api\data.db (a 51 MB copy is in the share at \\172.16.214.58\sap\LAN\data.db). The schema is documented only in comments (Conn/Magento.cs:164-172).
gap.ss: SQLiteDb.SetAsync (SQLiteDb.cs:158-176) swallows every SQL error, as LAN's DB.Set does (DB.cs:35-42). No ServicioSAP repo file creates the catalog tables, and no data.db is versioned. If SQLITE_DB_PATH (Web.config:59) points at a file without those tables, every DELETE and INSERT fails silently. E-19's GetAsync returns empty (:174), and CargaCompleta answers 200 true with nothing written (CatalogController.cs:26).
gap.action: Either point SQLITE_DB_PATH at the importer's data.db (G13-03 option A), or ship a schema script / seeded data.db with the seven catalog tables for every environment. Optionally add a startup or first-call check that the tables exist, so CargaCompleta does not report success on an empty schema.

results.title: LAN processes outside the DMZ routes

compare.summary:
G14 covers the LAN processes that the DMZ does not proxy. All findings were read from the code on 2026-10-06. LAN has no scheduler of its own: Global.asax.cs:12-15 and App_Start/WebApiConfig.cs:11-24 register only routes and the JWT handler. Every LAN background process is therefore either an HTTP endpoint called by something outside the repos, or a fire-and-forget thread inside a request.

**What is outside the DMZ**
- 17 LAN routes have no DMZ route that forwards to them:
  - customer/getCuenta and customer/setCuenta.
  - order/createStorepickupCode, order/generateNewStorepickupCode, order/getOrderId, order/getOrderInfoAndSet and order/checkOpenpay.
  - order/setOrderStatus. The DMZ route with the same name goes straight to Magento (DMZ OrdersController.cs:324-333). The LAN route is a separate inbound process (LAN OrdersController.cs:310-344) that also creates the virtual-article purchase.
  - All 9 LAN product/* routes. The DMZ product/* routes go to Magento, and the LAN routes are the jobs of the ImportApp.
- Background work found:
  - The liberador thread and its Magento authorizationResult callback (LAN CreditMethods.cs:208-241).
  - The Openpay CheckStatus and CheckStoresStatus job (LAN OpenpayMethods.cs:70-206).
  - The catalog sync plus the product import job (LAN ProductsController.cs:17-212).
  - Emails: the pickup email through Magento, the bank-transfer pickup email over SMTP, and the wholesale purchase email over SMTP (Provider.cs:72-97).
  - The Magento callbacks: setOrderStatus x5, setCAccount, authorizationResult, sendStorePickupEmail, and the product pushes.
- No caller for any of these is in LAN, DMZ, ServicioSAP or the Magento code. C-15 (IIS logs and the Task Scheduler list) is still open and blocks every switch in this group.

**Parity verdict, by area**

*Pickup*
- ServicioSAP has the writers: StorePickupMethods.cs:172-447 (SIGMavi BpRecogePedidos, SD36 to BP).
- createStorepickupCode is PARTIAL:
  - The verb is GET instead of POST, and the response is a JSON string instead of "ok".
  - The phone is not reduced to digits.
  - An update overwrites the contact fields.
  - The email is skipped when setOrderStatus fails.
  - products [] is accepted: Magento ignores it for the store_pickup status (BAJA_getOrderId.md §7).
- generateNewStorepickupCode exists, but it emails over its own SMTP template instead of Magento's sendStorePickupEmail. The docs propose retiring it (R7d-6).

*Openpay*
- checkOpenpay is MISSING in ServicioSAP:
  - Card orders are saved to SQLite and nothing reads them (OrderMethods.cs:1777-1786). A paid openpay_cards order is never created in SAP.
  - The expiry of unpaid Paynet references is never handled (OrderMethods.cs:1788-1792).
  - There are no Openpay keys or SDK in ServicioSAP.

*LAN inbound setOrderStatus*
- MISSING (R7-1). It needs a SAP-to-Magento status trigger and a replacement for the purchase in SPCOMSCompraArtVirtual.

*Liberador*
- BLOCKED by DU11 (Valentín, the liberador team).
- LiberadorCreditoMethods is ported correctly, but the trigger is commented out (OrderMethods.cs:673-707), and that block would not compile as written.
- The callback keys are snake_case (OrderMethods.cs:1257-1263), but the DMZ expects camelCase (T1a/CX-17).

*Catalog sync*
- PARTIAL. catalog/* E-16..E-24 match the SQLite part.
- The MySQL and Intelisis legs of E-19 are postponed by the 7 Sep decision until Dev 2 Sprint 9.
- cargaCompleta does not include deletePromociones, and nothing calls catalog/* (C-16).

*Product import, price, stock and configurable pushes*
- BLOCKED on Dev 2 Sprint 9 and the importer team (P10-1, D-53).
- ServicioSAP only has read sources:
  - product/exportaart/ma (EcommerceMethods). VIU and MAVI return "no implementado".
  - product/stock and product/stock/filter, which return raw DIM11 rows.
  - etiquetas.
- Nothing pushes to Magento.

*Other routes*
- obtenerImagen (E-14) is PARTIAL: it overwrites an existing file and creates the folder, where LAN returned an error.
- customer/getCuenta and setCuenta are PARTIAL only on the failure contract: LAN returns 200 with e.Message, ServicioSAP returns 500 after 3 retries. CQ24 was unanswered on 2026-10-05.
- getOrderId, getOrderInfoAndSet and getStockByStore are RETIRE_CANDIDATE: the docs retire them, but user confirmation and caller checks are pending.

**Emails**
- The bank-transfer pickup email in ServicioSAP (MailHelper.cs:63-111, called from OrderMethods.cs:1969) differs from LAN in three ways:
  - It uses the "your order is ready" text, where LAN tells the customer to share the code with the branch seller (CodigoRecogerSucursal.cs:718-720).
  - It prints the Magento entityId as "No. de orden", where LAN printed the increment id (:714).
  - It hardcodes the year 2021.

**Changes since the 2026-10-05 matrix (§4.1)**
- §4.1 has no rows for LAN-only routes. Its order/setOrderStatus row (out_of_scope, Magento) misses the LAN inbound process R7-1.
- The S1-S4 uncommitted edits touch this group only through MagentoAccountMethods.cs:25 and :35 (ConfigureAwait), with no change in behavior.
- The SD36 folio problem in the pickup writers is fixed centrally (SalesMethods.cs:139-140, :216-224). The Business Rules doc and R7d-5 still describe it as open.
- The shared Curl caches the DMZ token for 20 minutes (Curl.cs:17-20, :55-91), so "one login per attempt" in 01_CustomersController.md is stale (D-17).

**Notes (not parity gaps)**
- SD36 is hardcoded to Nodos.ENVIROMENT_DEV and sap-client=110 (SalesMethods.cs:146).
- SMTP credentials are hardcoded in MailHelper.cs:113-117, as they were in LAN. Value masked.
- E-22 calls the stage-delta productWithWebsites template, which origin/Production does not expose (D-54).
- Out of the group's scope, but seen here: the deferred Task.Run writes inside DMZ-proxied credit routes (CreditController.cs:219, :411; CreditMethods.cs:972, :2410, :2421) belong to the credit groups. CreditoWeb_SaveData is Credilana and out of scope.

results.title: Processes found missing by the completeness critic

compare.summary:
G15 covers 14 processes. None of their routes goes through the DMZ to ServicioSAP today. The SS product, catalog, pickup and MovBita routes have no DMZ route. The LAN import/stock jobs and the two pickup writers are triggered from outside the three repos (C-15/C-16, still NO EVIDENCE), and DMZ product/* goes straight to Magento.

(1) Product import, per store and per step, instead of G14's single BLOCKED. Store ma is PARTIAL: 6 of 15 rules are equal. SS EcommerceMethods ports the SP_eCommerceexportaMA filters, contado/credit-12 prices, the 7 stock rules, categories, relations and position. It is missing:
- configurables (FASE 14 commented out)
- attribute validation (pending since the 2026-09-07 decision)
- Viñeta description and Region6/TELEFONIA handling
- the LAN C# special-price override (category and liquidation discount, round half-up)
- the whole credit price matrix (credit_fee/credit_months and the 16 credit_price_* fields)
- any persistence (SQLite products / eComerceExportaArt)
It also fails open on the image filter and silently returns 200 with a null result on any error. Stores viu and mavi are MISSING (BadRequest at ProductController.cs:33-38). Etiquetas is PARTIAL: it only reads the SAP tag source, so all of generaEtiqueta's business transformation is missing, and without idEtiqueta it lists nothing. The optimized-image filter route is EQ to the SP's FASE 7 query. The SS stock reads (DIM11) are EQ as a data source, but the three LAN stock jobs (updateStock delta, updateStockMavi, existenciasAlmacenArt) are MISSING; only catalog/deleteReservations exists. ecommerce/listado is a diagnostic dump with no LAN counterpart.

(2) Store pickup. SS createStorepickupCode is PARTIAL: same CRC code and the same Magento setOrderStatus/sendStorePickupEmail calls. But it is GET where LAN is POST, it does not keep only the digits of the phone (SIGMAVI Telefono is BIGINT per the vault), on update it overwrites name/email/phone, even with blanks when SAP fails, and its response differs. SS generateNewStorepickupCode is DIF: it sends its own SMTP mail with an outdated template and never calls Magento sendStorePickupEmail, as LAN does. It returns a JSON-in-string instead of the bare code, and it rotates the code before a lookup that can fail. A joint retire decision is still open (C-15).

(3) MovBita is a candidate source for order/creditStatus, but not usable as is. It is keyed by Vbeln, returns raw events instead of {status}, and has no known vocabulary for AUTORIZADO/RECHAZADO/EN_ANALISIS. It should be added as option (E) to Q-T2-1, conditional on the credit area confirming that the web credit analysis writes ZSDT_MOVBITA.

No code in these files changed since 2026-10-05: the S1-S4 uncommitted edits do not touch them. However, §4.1 line 43 ('pickup code is done, only the connection is missing') is inaccurate.

Notes, not parity gaps: SMTP credentials are hardcoded in both repos (SS Helpers/MailHelper.cs:115-117, LAN Metodos/StorePickup/CodigoRecogerSucursal.cs:757-762) and should move to Web.config. MovBitaMethods uses an HttpClient with no timeout and no auth. The full SP sources for the export are in .agents/skills/lan-sap-migration/SPsOrden/; SpVTASEcommerceExistencia, SpVTASECommerceDisponibilidadArt and SpVTASEcommercePrecio are not there.

# Parity LAN vs ServicioSAP - every process - 2026-10-06

Code read on 2026-10-06, read-only. No edits, SQL or HTTP calls were made. Versions:
- ServicioSAP: HEAD 6214ed8 plus the uncommitted S1-S4 edits.
- DMZ: branch ConexionSAP 09cb341 (clean).
- LAN: stage-delta (68b2290). origin/Production was used where noted.
- Magento248 app/code was used for callers.

Every group comparison was checked adversarially. This report applies that check:
- REFUTED gaps are dropped.
- CORRECTED texts and status corrections are applied.
- Missed gaps found by the verifier are added.
- The completeness critic's notes are resolved in §1.1.

Status legend:
- **EQ**: same business rules.
- **EQ_ACCEPTED**: same, except differences the user already accepted.
- **PARTIAL**: route exists with some rules missing.
- **DIF**: route exists but behaves differently in a way that matters.
- **MISSING**: no ServicioSAP equivalent and nobody outside is blocking it.
- **BLOCKED**: waiting on another team or system.
- **RETIRE_CANDIDATE**: proposed for retirement, pending the user.
- **OUT_OF_SCOPE**: Magento-direct, DMZ-local, Credilana, APP mercancías or Neko.

## 1. Answer

**161 processes** were compared: DMZ routes, LAN-only routes, LAN background jobs and the ServicioSAP routes that replace them, in 15 groups.

| Status | Count |
|---|---|
| EQ | 7 |
| EQ_ACCEPTED | 6 |
| PARTIAL | 31 |
| DIF | 11 |
| MISSING | 22 |
| BLOCKED | 22 |
| RETIRE_CANDIDATE | 19 |
| OUT_OF_SCOPE | 43 |
| **Total** | **161** |

- **13 processes are at business-rule parity** (EQ + EQ_ACCEPTED).
- 99 processes have to keep working after LAN is switched off (161 minus 43 out of scope and 19 retire candidates). Only 13 of those 99 are at parity today.
- Verified gaps: **376 confirmed** and **3 refuted**.
- By need: 182 DECISION, 96 CODE, 75 EXTERNAL, 21 DATA, 2 CONFIG.
- The counts include some deliberate duplicates where two groups saw the same defect from different routes. For example, the Openpay job appears as G04-01, G06-19 and G14-14. The pickup writers appear as G14-04..07 and G15-30..34.

**What it takes to reach LAN business-rule parity.** Four things come first:

1. **Close the order/new defects that corrupt data today.** No decision is needed for these.
   - SAP errors are treated as success (G04-27).
   - The cancel lookup builds ZSD_T_/ZSD_P_, so every Magento cancel fails (G06-01).
   - The liberador callback keys are wrong (T1a).
   - The ZidMagento PATCH has no sap-client (G10-02).
   - Customers born before 1970 cannot log in (G7-19).
   - recuperarcuenta has an injectable filter (G02-07).
   - The store_pickup status is rejected by Magento (G14-43).
2. **Take about 12 high-impact decisions that are open today.**
   - Customer create-or-reuse (D-19).
   - The setOrder response contract (R7a-1/C-11).
   - Openpay (D-38).
   - Pricing: precioEspecial and the SD29 floor (R7a-4).
   - The cash payment term (G04-28).
   - Cancel and return policy (D-35/D-36).
   - Credit gate eligibility (D-48).
   - The GetAccountDebts and getClienteFactura contracts (D-43, D-52).
   - Wallet (D-28/D-29).
   - Ownership of the catalog and import jobs (C-16).
   - The pickup routes and their caller (C-15).
3. **Get deliveries from other teams.**
   - The liberador contract (DU11, Valentín).
   - The SD annulment API ZIDSTATUS=03 and the ZIdEcommerce OData (SAP SD).
   - The payment-intent write target (R8-08/R8-09, Dev 4/ABAP).
   - The credit-balance sources (N1-N6).
   - Dev 2 Sprint 9 for the product, price and stock jobs.
4. **Load the data that ServicioSAP reads but nobody fills.**
   - servicio_guias.
   - BpRecogePedidos (open codes).
   - mavi_credilana_info.
   - The SIGMAVI coupon and condition rows.
   - The Openpay keys and the RECHAZAOPENPAY list.

Until (1) and (2) are closed, the routes already switched to ServicioSAP produce wrong data on real traffic: setCustomer, setOrder, cancelOrder, returnOrder, GetAccountDebts, getClienteFactura, wallet/details and getMinimumCostToRedeem.

### 1.1 Critic notes resolved

| Topic | Resolution |
|---|---|
| Neko trio (ApplyPaymentNeko, UpdateStatusPaymentNeko, bbvaKeyNeko) | **OUT_OF_SCOPE** in every group. The SS stubs (AbonosController.cs:51-84) must never be connected. The DMZ still forwards to LAN (DMZ CustomerServiceController.cs:164, :197, :272). |
| POST order/authorizationResult | The route is **OUT_OF_SCOPE**: a Magento pass-through (DMZ OrdersController.cs:421-458; 10-05 matrix row 118). The real gap is on the caller side and is tracked once, under the liberador row (G14, BLOCKED). It holds the CX-17/T1a key fix as CODE (OrderMethods.cs:1257-1263). G05 no longer reports a DIF. |
| POST order/validateCredit | One status: **RETIRE_CANDIDATE**. The DMZ route is inside a block comment (DMZ OrdersController.cs:366-402), so it is not a live DMZ route. The LAN route is still live (LAN OrdersController.cs:457-483) with no DMZ caller. |
| Store pickup codes | createStorepickupCode and generateNewStorepickupCode are both **DIF**. Both are implemented in StorePickupMethods. Both share the joint keep-or-retire question (C-15, REVISION 2026-10-05:902). |
| Product import | Split per store and step (G15). Store ma is PARTIAL. viu and mavi are MISSING (ProductController.cs:33-38 return "no implementado"). etiquetas is PARTIAL. The optimized-image filter is EQ. The DIM11 stock reads are EQ. ecommerce/listado is RETIRE_CANDIDATE. The LAN push jobs (product, price, stock) are BLOCKED on C-16 and Dev 2 Sprint 9. |
| Agent lookup (setOrder Agente vs GetEmpleadoByNomina) | One joint decision, **DEC-25**: is SuccessFactors (partner/successfactor/employee, BusinessPartnerController.cs:180-194) the agent source for both? The setOrder agent row stays BLOCKED, because it also needs MAVI's generic agent. GetEmpleadoByNomina stays MISSING. Both are tied to DEC-25. |
| MovBita | It is not a separate process. It is recorded as **option (E)** of the creditStatus source decision (Q-T2-1, DEC-32). It is valid only if the credit area confirms that web credit writes ZSDT_MOVBITA. |

## 2. What changed since 2026-10-05

### 2.1 S1-S4 code (uncommitted ServicioSAP working copy; nothing tested end to end yet, S6)

| Change | Where |
|---|---|
| partner/client returns the BP number as a string, `Ok(result.Partner.Trim())`, instead of the whole Client object | BusinessPartnerController.cs:60 |
| An empty Partner from BP01 returns 200 `"Error, <to_return>"` (CQ6/CQ8 option d) | BusinessPartnerController.cs:48-59 |
| Sntz on the same 7 fields as LAN (CQ7). New helper. | SntzMethods.cs:12-28; BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:394-405 |
| NameFirst, NameLast, NameLst2 and SmtpAddr are stored in UPPERCASE (CQ1=B) | BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:394-397, :484 |
| `int.Parse(Sntz(idMagento))` replaces ParseMagentoId (CQ5) | BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:401-404 |
| Dead code removed (CQ9). Lines in BusinessPartnerMethods shifted by about 56. | e.g. GetClientMaAsync :266-309, LinkMagentoAccountAsync :779-819, GetWholesaleCustomerNameAsync :856-884 |
| setCustomerList: email URL-encoded in the BP05 filter (CQ13); SQL errors rethrown (CQ12=A) | CustomerMethods.cs:83, :68 |
| ConfigureAwait(false) only, no behavior change | CashReportMethods.cs:67; MagentoAccountMethods.cs:25, :35 |

### 2.2 Side effects of S1-S4 found today

- Uppercase storage breaks lookups that match exact text:
  - setCustomerList BP05 `Mail eq` (CustomerMethods.cs:82-83, G01-07).
  - recuperarcuenta `PrimerNombre eq` (ProspectoController.cs:47, G02-06).
- The order BP builder (OrderMethods.cs:2659-2730) has neither Sntz nor uppercase. Customer masters now come out in two formats (G04-08/09).
- The anonymized real payload captured for CQ10 (idMagento "") now fails at BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:404 (G01-04, a release risk).

### 2.3 Other changes found

- **No business code changed** since 2026-10-05 in order, credit, wallet, customerService, abonos, catalog, pickup or product. The DMZ is unchanged.
- The credit rule count is now **120/160** (it was 119): TEL-1 (2026-10-02) closes G3-04.
- The 10-05 matrix is stale on several points that are already fixed in code:
  - getCustomerList and deleteCustomerList (CQ12).
  - The partner/client response.
  - The SD36 folio in the pickup writers (SalesMethods.cs:139-140, :216-224).
  - The bank-transfer pickup code (ported in 61eb2c3, OrderMethods.cs:1959-1975).
- New critical or high findings in this pass:
  - order/new treats a SAP response with `to_return` Type E and an empty `Salesdocument` as success. It then runs the address, setCAccount and pickup steps (OrderMethods.cs:1890-1975; sap.log 2026-07-17) — **G04-27**.
  - Every Magento cancel fails. Magento sends tipo T/P, so FullCancelAsync searches ZSD_T_/ZSD_P_ (OrderMethods.cs:3010-3011) — **G06-01**.
  - Every RMA fails. Magento sends no `store`, so the call throws "No lleva id de tienda" (OrderMethods.cs:366-368), the DMZ answers 200 and Magento marks the RMA synced — **G06-07**.
  - Cash orders are booked with the article's 12-month credit term (OrderMethods.cs:2255-2277) — **G04-28**.
  - The cash region rewrite reads `estado` instead of the postal code and corrupts phone SKUs, e.g. -R5 becomes -RJ (OrderMethods.cs:1828, :2116-2181) — **G04-13**.
  - The SD29 price floor takes an arbitrary row across org, condition and branch (FinalListProperMethods.cs:82-85; OrderMethods.cs:2014) — **G04-11**.
  - Magento rejects every credit order of a BP customer while the gate GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName stays on LAN (Magento SaveOrder.php:42-49) — **G10-22**.
  - createStorepickupCode sends `products: []`, which Magento checkParams rejects. ServicioSAP still reports success (StorePickupMethods.cs:430) — **G14-43**.
  - recuperarcuenta builds an anonymous, injectable OData filter that can disclose BP numbers (ProspectoController.cs:47) — **G02-07**.
  - getClienteFactura ignores `{cliente}` and returns any invoice's installments (AbonoMethods.cs:68) — **G11-07**.
  - wallet/details serializes with System.Text.Json. Magento strips backslashes, so accented text arrives garbled (WalletCustomerController.cs:50) — **G03-07**.
  - The ZidMagento PATCH has no sap-client=110 (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:786-787) — **G10-02**.
  - The order BP stores ZidMagento=0, because the payload sends `cliente`, not `idMagento` (OrderMethods.cs:2826) — **G04-29**.
  - DMZ GetPickUpCode still reads LAN, while order/new writes new pickup codes to SIGMAVI (DMZ OrdersController.cs:262) — **G06-13** (corrected).
  - The exportaart image filter fails open and publishes articles without images (EcommerceMethods.cs:623-627, :641-645) — **G15-01**.

### 4.2 Decisions for the user

Ordered by impact. Each one names LAN file:line, ServicioSAP file:line, options, recommendation and an example.

**DEC-01 — setCustomer create-or-reuse (critical) — G01-01; also G04-07 for order/new.**
- LAN: SP_eCommerceCtenuevo.sql:62-68 looks up Cte.IdMagento (plus eMail1 when the id is ≤2), :172-206 updates the row, and the same @Clave is returned.
- ServicioSAP: BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:435 sends Partner=""; BusinessPartnerController.cs:46-60 has no lookup. OrderMethods.cs:2603-2634 calls BP01 every time cuenta is empty.
- Options: (a) return the existing BP; (b) also update names and email with a partial BP01; (c) replicate the SP update, including the address wipe; (d) keep creating.
- Recommendation: (a) or (b) without the address wipe, with the tie-break on the highest Partner. Only a "No se encontraron clientes" result may lead to a create.
- First run step 0 (D-15): `GET partner/client/filter/ZidMagento eq <id>`. CQ3: do guests (id 0-2) get one BP per email?
- Example: a customer edits their profile twice. LAN keeps C0001234. ServicioSAP creates three BPs.

**DEC-02 — setOrder response contract, cash and credit (critical) — G04-25, G05-03.**

I compared all 161 processes (DMZ routes, LAN-only routes and LAN jobs) against the code as of today. Only **13 work the same way as in LAN**: 7 identical, 6 identical apart from differences you already accepted.

99 processes have to keep working after LAN is switched off, and 13 of them are at parity. I checked 379 gaps and confirmed 376 (3 were wrong). Of the confirmed gaps, 182 need a decision from you, 96 are code we can write, 75 depend on other teams, 21 on data and 2 on configuration.

**By group**
- **G01 Customers:** setCustomer is now *different*: every call or retry creates a new BP. The S1-S4 edits fixed the response, but uppercase emails broke the setCustomerList email check.

- **G05 Credit:** 120 of 160 rules equal. The liberador is not triggered (DU11), the callback keys are wrong, and creditStatus and updateCreditOrderId are blocked.
- **G06 Cancel/return:** every Magento cancel and every return fails today (T/P lookup; store missing).
- **G07 Customer service:** customers born before 1970 cannot log in; four routes are missing.
- **G08 Payments:** GetAccountDebts returns raw SAP rows, which breaks Magento. Payment intents wait on Dev 4.
- **G09:** obtenerCreditos does not show pending or rejected credit requests; coverage and shipment status are missing.
- **G10 SMS/coupon:** the credit gate route is missing, so Magento rejects every credit order of a BP customer. The ZidMagento update is missing sap-client=110.
- **G11 Balances:** getClienteFactura makes the DMZ answer 500 and ignores the customer; balances wait on SAP captures.
- **G12 CreditoWeb:** 5 routes are out of scope (Credilana / APP mercancías); 5 are missing and wait on the APERTURA / ProductosMX decision.

- **G15 Product export:** store ma is partial (no configurables, credit prices or persistence; it publishes articles without images); viu and mavi are missing.
